## busybox-制作一个小文件系统

linux系统启动阶段，boot
loader加载完内核文件vmlinuz后，内核紧接着需要挂载磁盘根文件系统initramfs根文件系统，其中包含必要的设备驱动和工具，bootloader加载initramfs到内存中，内核会将其挂载到根目录/,然后运行/init脚本，挂载真正的磁盘根文件系统。

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| *#下载源码*                                                                       |
|                                                                                   |
| wget <https://busybox.net/downloads/busybox-1.32.1.tar.bz2>                       |
|                                                                                   |
| *#解压*                                                                           |
|                                                                                   |
| tar --xvf busybox-1.32.1.tar.bz2                                                  |
|                                                                                   |
| cd busybox-1.32.1                                                                 |
|                                                                                   |
| *#配置参数*                                                                       |
|                                                                                   |
| make menuconfig                                                                   |
|                                                                                   |
| *#多核心执行*                                                                     |
|                                                                                   |
| make --j 4                                                                        |
|                                                                                   |
| *#安装，其实就是生成一个_install目录*                                             |
|                                                                                   |
| make && make install                                                              |
|                                                                                   |
| *#创建个文件夹，构建文件系统*                                                     |
|                                                                                   |
| mkdir initramfs                                                                   |
|                                                                                   |
| *#拷贝_install文件夹到initramfs文件夹*                                            |
|                                                                                   |
| cp --rf /home/busybox-1.32.1/\_install/\* /home/initramfs/                        |
|                                                                                   |
| *#创建3个文件夹*                                                                  |
|                                                                                   |
| mkdir dev proc sys                                                                |
|                                                                                   |
| *#把/dev下的几个文件拷贝过来*                                                     |
|                                                                                   |
| sudo cp -a /dev/{null,console,tty,tty1,tty2,tty3,tty4} dev/                       |
|                                                                                   |
| *#干掉linuxrc文件*                                                                |
|                                                                                   |
| rm --f linuxrc                                                                    |
|                                                                                   |
| *#创建init文件*                                                                   |
|                                                                                   |
| vim init                                                                          |
|                                                                                   |
| #!/bin/busybox sh                                                                 |
|                                                                                   |
| echo \"{==DBG==} INIT SCRIPT\"                                                    |
|                                                                                   |
| mount -t proc none /proc                                                          |
|                                                                                   |
| mount -t sysfs none /sys                                                          |
|                                                                                   |
| echo -e \"{==DBG==} Boot took \$(cut -d\' \' -f1 /proc/uptime) seconds\"          |
|                                                                                   |
| exec /sbin/init                                                                   |
|                                                                                   |
| *#打包整个目录并创建个压缩文件*                                                   |
|                                                                                   |
| find . -print0 \| cpio \--null -ov \--format=newc \|gzip -9 \>                    |
| ../initramfs.cpio.gz                                                              |
|                                                                                   |
| *#选择Busybox Settings\-\--\>Build Options\-\--\>，选择\[\*\] Build Busybox as a  |
| static binary（no shared libs）*                                                  |
|                                                                                   |

## GDB命令说明

+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| start                             | 启动调试                          |
+===================================+===================================+
| n                                 | 单步调试                          |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| s                                 | 进入函数                          |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| p                                 | 查看变量值\                       |
|                                   | set print pretty on  格式化       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| break \*0x7c00                    | 设置0x7c00断点                    |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| b start_kernel                    | 根据方法名设置断点                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| info br                           | 显示所有断点                      |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| delete breakpoints 1              | 删除1号断点                       |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| info r                            | 查看寄存器                        |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| x/ \<n/f/u\>\<addr\>              | 查看内存信息，                    |
|                                   |                                   |
| x /30xg 0xffffffff82de7000        | 其中 n 、 f 、 u 都是可选参数，   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | n 表示重复次数，                  |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | f 表示显示格式（format），        |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--x 按十六进制格式显示变量   |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--d 按十进制格式显示变量     |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--o 按八进制格式显示变量     |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--t 按二进制格式显示变量     |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | u 表示显示单元大小(unix           |
|                                   | size)默认是4个bytes               |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--b表示单字节，              |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--h表示双字节，              |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--w表示四字节，              |
|                                   |                                   |
|                                   | \-\-\--g表示八字节                |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+
| disassemble 0xfffff               | 反汇编代码 disas                  |
+-----------------------------------+-----------------------------------+

## qemu虚拟机-调试linux内核

QEMU是一个托管的虚拟机，它通过动态的二进制转换，模拟CPU，并且提供一组设备模型，使它能够运行多种未修改的客户机OS，可以通过与KVM一起使用进而接近本地速度运行虚拟机

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| <https://www.qemu.org/>                                               |
|                                                                       |
| *#下载*                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| https://www.qemu.org/download/#linux                                  |
|                                                                       |
| *#安装qemu*                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| *wget                                                                 |
| <http://mirror.centos.org/centos/7/os/x86_64/RPM-GPG-KEY-CentOS-7>*   |
|                                                                       |
| *wget http://mirrors.aliyun.com/repo/epel-7.repo*                     |
|                                                                       |
| yum install qemu-system-x86qemu-kvm                                   |
|                                                                       |
| *#qemu启动内核*                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| qemu-system-x86_64 -kernel ./arch/x86/boot/bzImage -initrd            |
| ../initramfs.cpio.gz -append \"nokaslr console=ttyS0\" -s -S          |
| -nographic                                                            |

## clion remote debug linux

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #先在centos 上启动qemu ，再远程连接到centos                           |
|                                                                       |
| \[root@localhost linux-5.17\]# pwd                                    |
|                                                                       |
| /home/linux-5.17                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| #gdb 远程连接不能用root ，需要设置，默认不能用root用户                |
|                                                                       |
| chown-Rwf:wf/home/linux-5.17                                          |
|                                                                       |
| #其他用户没有读权限                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| chmod+r/boot/initramfs-5.17.0.img                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 在centos上启动qemu                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| su-wf                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| cd/home                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| qemu-system-x86_64 --kernel ./linux-5.17/arch/x86/boot/bzImage        |
| --initrd /boot/initramfs-5.17.0.img --append \"nokaslr                |
| console=ttyS0\" --S --nographic -gdb tcp::1234                        |
|                                                                       |
| #把linux导入到clion                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #设置部署目录                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| Setting/Build,Execution,Deployment/Deployment                         |
| =\>设置Deploymentpath:/home/linux-5.17                                |
|                                                                       |
| \# clion debug 自动连接qemu，端口默认是1234，关闭防火墙               |
|                                                                       |
| 要想在clion 构建linux kernel ，需要用remote host                      |
| 方式构建项目，让windows下的clion 具有linux                            |
| 环境，这样所有的方法之间的调用关系就都有了，下面是设置如何上传并编译  |
|                                                                       |
| 否则会出现下面的错误                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| make \--makefile=Makefileclean                                        |

## 关于gcc编译内嵌汇编的说明

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| asm\<optional stuff\> (                                               |
|                                                                       |
|     \"assembler template\"                                            |
|                                                                       |
|     : outputs                                                         |
|                                                                       |
|     : inputs                                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     : clobbers                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| : labels)                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| r specifies that the operand must be a general-purpose register       |
|                                                                       |
| m specifies that the operand must be a memory address                 |
|                                                                       |
| i specifies that the operand must be an integer constant              |
|                                                                       |
| g specifies that the operand must be a general-purpose register, or a |
| memory address, or an integer constant (effectively the same as       |
| \"rmi\")                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| *#编译前*                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #define savesegment(seg, value)  asm(\"mov %%\" #seg \",%0\":\"=r\"   |
| (value) : : \"memory\")                                               |
|                                                                       |
| *#编译后对应的汇编代码*                                               |
|                                                                       |
| mov %gs,%eax                                                          |
+=======================================================================+

## Sparse 语法检查

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| https://www.cnblogs.com/wang_yb/p/3575039.html                        |
|                                                                       |
| Sparse通过 gcc 的扩展属性 \_\_attribute\_\_ 以及自己定义的            |
| \_\_context\_\_ 来对代码进行静态检查                                  |
|                                                                       |
| *#参考linux文档*                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| <https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/v4.11/dev-tools/sparse.html>         |
|                                                                       |
| <https://sparse.docs.kernel.org/en/latest/>                           |
|                                                                       |
| *#内核定义的类型*                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| D:\\linux\\linux-6.1.1\\include\\linux\\compiler_types.h              |
+=======================================================================+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  宏名称               宏定义                          检查点
  -------------------- ------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------
  \_\_bitwise          \_\_attribute\_\_((bitwise))    确保变量是相同的位方式(比如 bit-endian,
                                                       little-endiandeng)

  \_\_user             \_\_attribute\_\_((noderef,     指针地址必须在用户地址空间
                       address_space(1)))              

  \_\_kernel           \_\_attribute\_\_((noderef,     指针地址必须在内核地址空间
                       address_space(0)))              

  \_\_iomem            \_\_attribute\_\_((noderef,     指针地址必须在设备地址空间
                       address_space(2)))              

  \_\_safe             \_\_attribute\_\_((safe))       变量可以为空

  \_\_force            \_\_attribute\_\_((force))      变量可以进行强制转换

  \_\_nocast           \_\_attribute\_\_((nocast))     参数类型与实际参数类型必须一致

  \_\_acquires(x)      \_\_attribute\_\_((context(x,   参数x
                       0, 1)))                         在执行前引用计数必须是0,执行后,引用计数必须为1

  \_\_releases(x)      \_\_attribute\_\_((context(x,   与 \_\_acquires(x) 相反
                       1, 0)))                         

  \_\_acquire(x)       \_\_context\_\_(x, 1)           参数x 的引用计数 + 1

  \_\_release(x)       \_\_context\_\_(x, -1)          与 \_\_acquire(x) 相反

  \_\_cond_lock(x,c)   ((c) ? ({ \_\_acquire(x); 1; }) 参数c 不为0时,引用计数 + 1, 并返回1
                       : 0)                            
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## X86-Boot 引导过程

\# arch/x86/boot/bzImage是一个带启动扇区的55 AA

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| D:\\linux\\linux-6.1.1\\arch\\x86\\boot\\header.S                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| 系统的引导声明在header的汇编文件里                                                               |
|                                                                                                  |
| BOOTSEG = 0x07C0 /\* boot引导地址声明 \*/                                                        |
|                                                                                                  |
| #这是前512字节，由build.c程序填充，后面是引导开始，硬盘第一个扇区可以使用其他的引导工具比如grub2 |
|                                                                                                  |
|     .globl  hdr                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| hdr:                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
| setup_sects:    .byte0         /\* Filled in by build.c \*/                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
| root_flags: .word ROOT_RDONLY                                                                    |
|                                                                                                  |
| syssize:    .long 0         /\* Filled in by build.c \*/                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
| ram_size:   .word0         /\* Obsolete \*/                                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
| vid_mode:   .word SVGA_MODE                                                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
| root_dev:   .word0         /\* Filled in by build.c \*/                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
| boot_flag:  .word0xAA55                                                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
| 从 start_of_setup标号开是的代码需要完成下面这些事情：                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
| - 将所有段寄存器的值设置成一样的内容                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
| - 设置堆栈                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
| - 设置 bss （静态变量区）                                                                        |
|                                                                                                  |
| - 跳转到 main.c 开始执行代码                                                                     |
|                                                                                                  |
| start_of_setup:                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# Force %es = %ds                                                                               |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    %ds, %ax                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    %ax, %es                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     cld                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# Apparently some ancient versions of LILO invoked the kernel with %ss != %ds,                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# which happened to work by accident for the old code.  Recalculate the stack                   |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# pointer if %ss is invalid.  Otherwise leave it alone, LOADLIN sets up the                     |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# stack behind its own code, so we can\'t blindly put it directly past the heap.                |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    %ss, %dx                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     cmpw    %ax, %dx    # %ds == %ss?                                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    %sp, %dx                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     je  2f      # -\> assume %sp is reasonably set                                               |
|                                                                                                  |
|     \# Invalid %ss, make up a new stack                                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    \$\_end, %dx                                                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
|     testb   \$CAN_USE_HEAP, loadflags                                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
|     jz  1f                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    heap_end_ptr, %dx                                                                    |
|                                                                                                  |
| 1:  addw    \$STACK_SIZE, %dx                                                                    |
|                                                                                                  |
|     jnc 2f                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
|     xorw    %dx, %dx    # Prevent wraparound                                                     |
|                                                                                                  |
| 2:  # Now %dx should point to the end of our stack space                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
|     andw    \$\~3, %dx    # dword align (might as well\...)                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
|     jnz 3f                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    \$0xfffc, %dx    # Make sure we\'re not zero                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
| 3:  movw    %ax, %ss                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movzwl  %dx, %esp   \# Clear upper half of %esp                                              |
|                                                                                                  |
|     sti         \# Now we should have a working stack                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# We will have entered with %cs = %ds+0x20, normalize %cs so                                    |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# it is on par with the other segments.                                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
|     pushw   %ds                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
|     pushw   \$6f                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
|     lretw                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                  |
| 6:                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# Check signature at end of setup                                                               |
|                                                                                                  |
|     cmpl    \$0x5a5aaa55, setup_sig                                                              |
|                                                                                                  |
|     jne setup_bad                                                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# Zero the bss                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    \$\_\_bss_start, %di                                                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
|     movw    \$\_end+3, %cx                                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
|     xorl    %eax, %eax                                                                           |
|                                                                                                  |
|     subw    %di, %cx                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     shrw    \$2, %cx                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
|     rep; stosl                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# D:\\linux\\linux-5.17\\arch\\x86\\boot\\main.c                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| \# Jump to C code (should not return)                                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
|     calll   main                                                                                 |
+==================================================================================================+

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# linux-5.17\\arch\\x86\\boot\\main.c                                |
|                                                                       |
| voidmain(void) *#系统引导从main方法开始*                              |
|                                                                       |
| \# linux-5.17\\arch\\x86\\boot\\pm.c *设置gdt全局描述符表*            |
|                                                                       |

| x86 function call convention, 64-bit:                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|   arguments           \|  callee-saved      \| extra caller-saved \| return                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \[callee-clobbered\]   \|                    \| \[callee-clobbered\] \|                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  rdi rsi rdx rcx r8-9 \| rbx rbp \[\*\] r12-15 \| r10-11             \| rax, rdx \[\*\*\]                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  ( rspisobviouslyinvariantacrossnormalfunctioncalls. (gcccan\'merge\'                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|    functionswhenitseestail-calloptimizationpossibilities) rflags is                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|    clobbered. Leftover arguments are passed over the stack frame.)                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \[\*\]  In the frame-pointers case rbp is fixed to the stack frame.                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \[\*\*\] for struct return values wider than 64 bits the return convention is a                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       bit more complex: up to 128 bits width we return small structures                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       straight in rax, rdx. For structures larger than that (3 wordsor                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       larger) the caller puts a pointer to an on-stack return struct                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       \[allocated in the caller\'s stack frame\] into the first argument - i.e.                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       into rdi. All other arguments shift up by one in this case.                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                        |
|       Fortunately this case is rare in the kernel.                                                                                                     |

## 虚拟内存布局-- 48位

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 参考                                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| <https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/x86/x86_64/mm.txt>          |
+=======================================================================+

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4级页表 48位 (下面是虚拟地址)                                                                   |
+=====================+=====================+=====================+===============================+
| 开始地址            | 结束地址            | 大小                | 说明                          |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0x0000000000000000  | 0x00007fffffffffff  | 128 TB              | 用户空间虚拟地址              |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0x0000800000000000  | 0xffff7fffffffffff  | 16M TB              | 空洞，没有使用                |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 　                  | 　                  | 　                  | 　                            |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0xffff880000000000  | 0xffff887fffffffff  | 0.5 TB              | 内核LDT remap for PTI         |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0xffff888000000000  | 0xffffc87fffffffff  | 64 TB               | direct mapping of all         |
|                     |                     |                     | physical memory               |
|                     |                     |                     | (page_offset_base)            |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0xffffc90000000000  | 0xffffe8ffffffffff  | 32 TB               | ioremap space                 |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0xffffea0000000000  | 0xffffeaffffffffff  | 1 TB                | virtual memory map            |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+
| 0xffffec0000000000  | 0xfffffbffffffffff  | 16 TB               | KASAN shadow memory           |
+---------------------+---------------------+---------------------+-------------------------------+

## 内存管理 - buddy

https://blog.csdn.net/jasonchen_gbd/article/details/44023801

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Linux内核中使用伙伴系统（buddy                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| system）算法来管理内存页。它把所有的空闲页放到11个链表中，每个链表分别管理大小为1，2，4，8，16，32，64，128，256，512，1024个页的内存块。当系统需要分配内存时，就可以从buddy系统中获取。例如，要申请一块包含4个页的连续内存，就直接从buddy系统中管理4个页连续内存的链表中获取。当系统释放内存时，则将释放的内存放回buddy系统对应的链表中，如果释放内存后发现有两块相邻的内存又可以合并为一个更高阶的内存块，例如释放4个页，而恰好相邻的内存也为4个页的空闲内存，则合并这两块内存并放到buddy系统管理8个连续页的链表中。同样的，如果系统需要申请3个页的连续内存，则只能在4个页的链表中获取，剩下的一个页被放到buddy系统中管理1个页的链表中。 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 连续物理内存管理 buddy allocator                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 非连续物理内存管理 vmalloc allocator                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 小块物理内存管理 slab allocator                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 高端物理内存管理 kmapper                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 初始化阶段物理内存管理 bootmem                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| /\*\* D:\\linux\\linux-5.17- 999\\mm\\memblock.c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* 从bootmem 到buddy内存管理的过渡                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* memblock_free_all - release free pages to the buddy allocator                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \*/                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| // start_kernel =\> mm_init =\> mem_init =\> memblock_free_all                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| void \_\_init memblock_free_all(void)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|     unsignedlong pages;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|     free_unused_memmap();                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-5.17- 999\\mm\\page_alloc.c                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* Common helper functions. Never use with \_\_GFP_HIGHMEM because the returned                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

Use alloc_pages and then kmap if                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| unsignedlong\_\_get_free_pages(gfp_tgfp_mask, unsignedintorder)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| /\*\*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* alloc_pages - Allocate pages.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* \@gfp: GFP flags.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* process is honoured when in process context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \*                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* Context: Can be called from any context, providing the appropriate GFP                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* flags are used.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
|  \* Return: The page on success or NULL if allocation fails.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
