## Linux中的方法提取

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| /\*                                                                            |
|                                                                                |
|     int max(int a,int b){                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         if(a \> b){                                                            |
|                                                                                |
|             return a                                                           |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|     }                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|                                                                                |
|  我们需要把c语言的方法全部截取出来进行独立分析，怎么办？我们可以根据{}进行截取 |
|                                                                                |
|    大括号有两种形式                                                            |
|                                                                                |
|    1{                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|         2{ 3}                                                                  |
|                                                                                |
|         4{ 5}                                                                  |
|                                                                                |
|    6}                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|    1{                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|         2{                                                                     |
|                                                                                |
|             3{ 4}                                                              |
|                                                                                |
|         5}                                                                     |
|                                                                                |
|    6}                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
| \*/                                                                            |
|                                                                                |
| def findAllMethodByFile(byte\[\] fileByte){                                    |
|                                                                                |
|     def i1 = \[\],i2 = \[\],i3 = \[\],mothods = \[\]                           |
|                                                                                |
|     //先找到所有的{ }                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|     for(int i=0;i\<fileByte.length;i++){                                       |
|                                                                                |
|         if(fileByte\[i\] == \'{\'){                                            |
|                                                                                |
|             i1 \<\< i                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         if(fileByte\[i\] == \'}\'){                                            |
|                                                                                |
|             i2 \<\< i                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         if(fileByte\[i\] == \'\\n\'){                                          |
|                                                                                |
|             i3 \<\< i                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|     }                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|     // 从每个}过滤出来多个{并取最大的那个}，这样嵌套的每个{}位置能对应上       |
|                                                                                |
|     def i4 = \[\]                                                              |
|                                                                                |
|     for(int i=0;i\<i2.size();i++){                                             |
|                                                                                |
|         i4\[i\] = i1.grep({it \< i2\[i\]}).max()                               |
|                                                                                |
|         i1.removeElement(i4\[i\])                                              |
|                                                                                |
|     }                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|     i1 = i4                                                                    |
|                                                                                |
|     for(int i=0;i\<i1.size();i++){ //性能有点低，这不是重点                    |
|                                                                                |
|         for(int j=0;j\<i1.size();j++){                                         |
|                                                                                |
|             // 如果一个} 出现在另一个 {}内，设置成0=\>删除，排除内部的{}       |
|                                                                                |
|             if(i1\[j\] \> i1\[i\] && i1\[j\] \< i2\[i\]){                      |
|                                                                                |
|                 i1\[j\] = 0                                                    |
|                                                                                |
|             }                                                                  |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|     }                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|     //遍历所有的{}                                                             |
|                                                                                |
|     for(int i=0;i\<i1.size();i++){                                             |
|                                                                                |
|         if(i1\[i\] == 0){                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|             continue                                                           |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         //找到{ 上面一个换行符                                                 |
|                                                                                |
|         for(int j=0;j\<i3.size()-1;j++){                                       |
|                                                                                |
|             if(i1\[i\] \> i3\[j\] && i1\[i\] \< i3\[j+1\]){                    |
|                                                                                |
|                 i1\[i\] = i3\[j-1\]                                            |
|                                                                                |
|             }                                                                  |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         if(i2\[i\] == null \|\| i1\[i\] == null ){ // 在注释里存在{}字符       |
|                                                                                |
|             continue                                                           |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         int len = i2\[i\] - i1\[i\] + 1                                        |
|                                                                                |
|         if(len \<0 ){                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|             continue                                                           |
|                                                                                |
|         }                                                                      |
|                                                                                |
|         byte\[\] tmp = new byte\[len\]                                         |
|                                                                                |
|         System.arraycopy(fileByte,i1\[i\],tmp,0,len)                           |
|                                                                                |
|         mothods \<\<new String(tmp)                                            |
|                                                                                |
|     }                                                                          |
|                                                                                |
|     return mothods                                                             |
|                                                                                |
| }                                                                              |
+================================================================================+

## 抽取linux kernel 方法

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# Clang AST 需要依赖 llvm 库， 可以通过 Homebrew 安装 llvm：         |
|                                                                       |
| brew install llvm                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 安装完成后， 需要clang模块 ModuleNotFoundError: No module named    |
| \'clang\'                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| python3 -m pip install clang                                          |
|                                                                       |
| \# 用 Python 的 clang 模块来解析 linux kernel                         |
| 函数，提取函数定义和相关信息                                          |
|                                                                       |
| from clang import cindex                                              |
|                                                                       |
| cindex.Config.set_library_file(                                       |
|                                                                       |
| \"/usr/local/opt/llvm/lib/libclang.dylib\"                            |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| index = cindex.Index.create()                                         |
|                                                                       |
| tu =                                                                  |
| index.parse(\"/Users/edy/Downloads/linux/linux-6.10/init/main.c\")    |
|                                                                       |
| def visit(node):                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| if node.kind == cindex.CursorKind.FUNCTION_DECL:                      |
|                                                                       |
| print(\"Function:\", node.spelling)                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #print(\"Return type:\", node.result_type.spelling)                   |
|                                                                       |
| print(\"Location:\", node.location)                                   |
|                                                                       |
| for child in node.get_children():                                     |
|                                                                       |
| visit(child)                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| visit(tu.cursor)                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| \# 执行                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| python3 abc.py                                                        |
+=======================================================================+

## for_each_online_node循环定义说明

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-5.17- 999\\include\\linux\\nodemask.h            |
|                                                                       |
|  \* Bitmasks that are kept for all the nodes.                         |
|                                                                       |
|  \*/                                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| enumnode_states {                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     N_POSSIBLE,     /\* The node could become online at some point    |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     N_ONLINE,       /\* The node is online \*/                        |
|                                                                       |
|     N_NORMAL_MEMORY,    /\* The node has regular memory \*/           |
|                                                                       |
| #ifdef CONFIG_HIGHMEM                                                 |
|                                                                       |
|     N_HIGH_MEMORY,      /\* The node has regular or high memory \*/   |
|                                                                       |
| #else                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
|     N_HIGH_MEMORY = N_NORMAL_MEMORY,                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #endif                                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     N_MEMORY,       /\* The node has memory(regular, high, movable)   |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     N_CPU,      /\* The node has one or more cpus \*/                 |
|                                                                       |
|     N_GENERIC_INITIATOR,    /\* The node has one or more Generic      |
| Initiators \*/                                                        |
|                                                                       |
|     NR_NODE_STATES                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| };                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| #define for_each_online_node(node) for_each_node_state(node,          |
| N_ONLINE)                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #define for_each_node_state(\_\_node, \_\_state)                      |
| for_each_node_mask((\_\_node), node_states\[\_\_state\])              |
|                                                                       |
| #define for_each_node_mask(node, mask) for ((node)                    |
| =first_node(mask);(node) \< MAX_NUMNODES;(node) =next_node((node),    |
| (mask)))                                                              |
+=======================================================================+

## schedule 调度器

抢占式调度器设置说明

CONFIG_PREEMPT=y
是开启了抢占式，这种模式响应速度非常快，但会降低并发的吞吐量

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| The term \"preemptible\" in the context of the Linux kernel refers to |
| the kernel\'s ability to preempt a currently running task to allow    |
| another, potentially higher-priority task to run. This feature is     |
| important for achieving better real-time performance and              |
| responsiveness, especially in systems requiring low-latency           |
| operations.                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| The Linux kernel supports several levels of preemption:               |
|                                                                       |
| 1\. \*\*No Preemption (CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE)\*\*: The kernel is not    |
| preemptible, except in user space or when a task voluntarily yields   |
| the CPU. This is suitable for systems where throughput is more        |
| critical than latency.                                                |
|                                                                       |
| 2\. \*\*Voluntary Preemption (CONFIG_PREEMPT_VOLUNTARY)\*\*: The      |
| kernel can be preempted at well-defined points, making it more        |
| responsive than the non-preemptible kernel but still not fully        |
| preemptible. This is a middle ground suitable for desktop systems     |
| where some responsiveness is needed, but throughput is also           |
| important.                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| 3\. \*\*Preemptible Kernel (CONFIG_PREEMPT)\*\*: The kernel can be    |
| preempted almost anywhere, making it more responsive. This option is  |
| suitable for systems where low-latency operation is important, such   |
| as desktop and mobile systems.                                        |
|                                                                       |
| 4\. \*\*Preempt-RT (Real-Time)\*\*: This is an additional set of      |
| patches and modifications that make the kernel more deterministic and |
| suitable for real-time applications. It aims to reduce the worst-case |
| latency and improve predictability.                                   |
|                                                                       |
| The strength or effectiveness of preemptibility in the Linux kernel   |
| depends on the specific configuration and the use case. For           |
| general-purpose use, the standard preemptible kernel                  |
| (\`CONFIG_PREEMPT\`) offers a good balance of responsiveness and      |
| performance. For more demanding real-time applications, the           |
| Preempt-RT patches provide the necessary features to achieve          |
| stringent latency requirements.                                       |
|                                                                       |
| Overall, the Linux kernel\'s preemptibility can be quite strong,      |
| especially with the Preempt-RT patches, allowing it to handle a wide  |
| range of applications, from general-purpose computing to real-time    |
| systems.                                                              |
+=======================================================================+

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \_\_schedule() is the main scheduler function.                        |
|                                                                       |
| //D:\\linux\\linux-5.17\\kernel\\sched\\core.c                        |
|                                                                       |
| staticvoid \_\_sched notrace \_\_schedule(unsignedintsched_mode)      |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     struct task_struct \*prev, \*next;                                |
|                                                                       |
|     unsignedlong \*switch_count;                                      |
|                                                                       |
|     unsignedlong prev_state;                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     struct rq_flags rf;                                               |
|                                                                       |
|     struct rq \*rq;                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     int cpu;                                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     cpu = smp_processor_id();                                         |

|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|       exit(2);                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|     }                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   }                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   constlonglongunsigneddelta = time_ns(&ts) - start_ns;                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   printf(\"%i system calls in %lluns (%.1fns/syscall)\\n\", iterations, delta, (delta / (float) iterations));                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   return0;                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| }                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- |

## Rust 基本练习

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| edy@edydeMacBook-Pro-3 abc % tree                                     |
|                                                                       |
| ├── src                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| │   ├── main.rs                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| │   └── second.rs                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| //https://www.runoob.com/rust/rust-tutorial.html                      |
|                                                                       |
| mod second;                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| use second::AddStruct;                                                |
|                                                                       |
| use second::Mess;                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| use std::thread;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| fn main() {                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| // Rust 中通过 std::thread::spawn 函数创建新线程                      |
|                                                                       |
| let handle = thread::spawn(Mess::thread_hello);                       |
|                                                                       |
| let mut a1 = AddStruct::opt(1,2);                                     |
|                                                                       |
| let mut res = a1.jia();                                               |
|                                                                       |
| println!(\"add result = {}\",res);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| a1 = AddStruct{ a:3,b:2};                                             |
|                                                                       |
| res = a1.jia();                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| println!(\"add result = {}\",res);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| let h = Mess::hello();                                                |
|                                                                       |
| println!(\"{}\",h);                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| handle.join().unwrap(); // 等待子线程完成                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| //=================================================================   |
|                                                                       |
| second.rs                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| pub struct AddStruct {                                                |
|                                                                       |
| pub a: i32,                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| pub b: i32,                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| impl AddStruct{                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| pub fn opt(v1: i32,v2: i32) -\> AddStruct {                           |
|                                                                       |
| return AddStruct{a:v1,b:v2};                                          |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| pub fn jia(&self) -\> i32{                                            |
|                                                                       |
| return self.a + self.b;                                               |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| use std::thread;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| use std::time::Duration;                                              |
|                                                                       |
| pub struct Mess;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| impl Mess {                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| pub fn hello() -\> &\'static str { // Added return type               |
|                                                                       |
| return \"wangfei, hehe \";                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| pub fn thread_hello() {                                               |
|                                                                       |
| for i in 0..5 {                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| println!(\"thread {} print hello\", i);                               |
|                                                                       |
| thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));                              |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |

## 自己写个网卡驱动模拟发包

参考：https://www.cnblogs.com/053179hu/p/14018654.html

wf.c

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #include \<linux/init.h\>                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/module.h\>                                           |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/device.h\>                                           |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/etherdevice.h\>                                      |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/netdevice.h\>                                        |
|                                                                       |
| MODULE_LICENSE(\"Dual BSD/GPL\");                                     |
|                                                                       |
| static struct net_device \*wf_dev;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| static void print_skb(struct sk_buff \*skb)                           |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| int i;                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| for (i = 0; i \< skb-\>len; i++) {                                    |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_CONT \"%02x \", \*(skb-\>head + i));                      |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"\\n\");                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\*\*                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \* 启动设备的时候做的一些初始化                                       |
|                                                                       |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| static void ethdev_setup(struct net_device \*dev)                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\*\*                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \* 发送数据包用的                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| static netdev_tx_t wf_start_xmit(struct sk_buff \*skb, struct         |
| net_device \*dev)                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"+++++++++++++++wf_start_xmit send data to far\");  |
|                                                                       |
| print_skb(skb);                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| netif_start_queue(dev);                                               |
|                                                                       |
| return 0; /\* NETDEV_TX_OK; \*/                                       |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\*\*                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \* 配置网卡设备的参数 include\\linux\\netdevice.h                     |
|                                                                       |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| static const struct net_device_ops wf_netdev_ops = {                  |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_start_xmit = wf_start_xmit,                                      |
|                                                                       |
| };                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| /\*\*                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \* 向内核注册模块的时候调用 insmod wf.ko                              |
|                                                                       |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| static int \_\_init wf_init(void)                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- hello wf\");                       |
|                                                                       |
| wf_dev = alloc_netdev(0, \"eth-wf-12\", NETDEV_ALIGN, ethdev_setup);  |
|                                                                       |
| if (!wf_dev) {                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_ERR \"wf: failed to allocate netdev\\n\");                |
|                                                                       |
| return -ENOMEM;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| wf_dev-\>netdev_ops = &wf_netdev_ops;                                 |
|                                                                       |
| if (register_netdev(wf_dev)) {                                        |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_ERR \"wf: failed to register netdev\\n\");                |
|                                                                       |
| free_netdev(wf_dev);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| return -ENODEV;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| return 0;                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\*\*                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \* 卸载模块 rmmod wf.ko                                               |
|                                                                       |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| static void \_\_exit wf_exit(void)                                    |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"good bye \>\>\>\>\>\>\> wf\");                     |
|                                                                       |
| unregister_netdev(wf_dev);                                            |
|                                                                       |
| free_netdev(wf_dev);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| module_init(wf_init);                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| module_exit(wf_exit);                                                 |
+=======================================================================+

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

|                                                                       |
| all:                                                                  |
|                                                                       |
|         make -C /lib/modules/\$(shell uname -r)/build M=\$(PWD)       |
| modules                                                               |

| staticstructnf_hook_ops \*nf_ops = NULL;                                                             |
|                                                                                                      |
| staticintii = 0;                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                      |
| staticvoidprint_skb(structsk_buff \*skb){                                                            |
|                                                                                                      |
|   inti = 0;                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                      |
|   for(i=0;i\<skb-\>len;i++){                                                                         |
|                                                                                                      |
|     printk(KERN_CONT \"%02x \", \*(skb-\>head + i) );                                                |
|                                                                                                      |
|   }                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                      |
|   printk(KERN_INFO \"\\n\" );                                                                        |
|                                                                                                      |
| }                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
| /\* 过滤器方法 nf_hookfn \*/                                                                         |
|                                                                                                      |
| staticunsignedintwf_netfilter_handler(void \*priv,structsk_buff \*skb,conststructnf_hook_state       |
| \*state)                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                      |
| {                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
|   printk(KERN_INFO \"\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>\>%d +++ \\n\", ii++);                            |
|                                                                                                      |
|   print_skb(skb);                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
|   return NF_ACCEPT;                                                                                  |

| }                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
| /\*\* 向内核注册模块的时候调用 insmod wf.ko \*/                                                      |
|                                                                                                      |
| staticintwf_init(void)                                                                               |
|                                                                                                      |
| {                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
|  printk(KERN_INFO \"\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- hello wf\");                                                     |
|                                                                                                      |
|  nf_ops = (structnf_hook_ops\*)kcalloc(1,  sizeof(structnf_hook_ops), GFP_KERNEL);                   |
|                                                                                                      |
|  if (nf_ops != NULL) {                                                                               |
|                                                                                                      |
|   [nf_ops-\>hook = (nf_hookfn\*)wf_netfilter_handler;]{.mark}                                        |
|                                                                                                      |
|   nf_ops-\>hooknum = NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING;                                                            |
|                                                                                                      |
|   nf_ops-\>pf = NFPROTO_IPV4;                                                                        |
|                                                                                                      |
|   nf_ops-\>priority = -10000; /\* NF_IP_PRI_FIRST;\*/                                                |
|                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                      |
|   nf_register_net_hook(&init_net, nf_ops);                                                           |
|                                                                                                      |
|  }                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                      |
|  return0;                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                      |
| }                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
| /\*\*卸载模块 rmmod wf.ko\*/                                                                         |
|                                                                                                      |
| staticvoidwf_exit(void) {                                                                            |
|                                                                                                      |
|   printk(KERN_INFO \"good bye \>\>\>\>\>\>\> wf\");                                                  |
|                                                                                                      |
|    if(nf_ops != NULL) {                                                                              |
|                                                                                                      |
|   nf_unregister_net_hook(&init_net, nf_ops);                                                         |
|                                                                                                      |
|   kfree(nf_ops);                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                      |
|  }                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                      |
| }                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                      |
| module_init(wf_init);                                                                                |
|                                                                                                      |
| module_exit(wf_exit);                                                                                |

## epoll多路复用IO接口

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| //系统调用 D:\\linux\\linux-5.17\\fs\\eventpoll.c                     |
|                                                                       |
| SYSCALL_DEFINE1(epoll_create, int, size)                              |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     if (size \<= 0)                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|         return -EINVAL;                                               |
|                                                                       |
|     return do_epoll_create(0);                                        |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| // Open an eventpoll file descriptor.                                 |
|                                                                       |
| staticintdo_epoll_create(int flags)                                   |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     interror, fd;                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     struct eventpoll \*ep = NULL;                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     struct file \*file;                                               |
|                                                                       |
|     //创建个ep 结构                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     error = ep_alloc(&ep);                                            |
|                                                                       |
|     //获取个空闲的文件描述符fd                                        |
|                                                                       |
|     fd = get_unused_fd_flags(O_RDWR \| (flags & O_CLOEXEC));          |
|                                                                       |
|     //好像是获取个文件                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     file = anon_inode_getfile(\"\[eventpoll\]\", &eventpoll_fops, ep, |
| O_RDWR \| (flags & O_CLOEXEC));                                       |
|                                                                       |
|     ep-\>file = file;                                                 |
|                                                                       |
|     //                                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     fd_install(fd, file);                                             |
|                                                                       |
|     return fd;                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |

|                                                                       |
| obj-m += wf.o                                                         |

|                                                                       |
| KDIR ?= /lib/modules/\$(shell uname -r)/build                         |
|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |
| PWD := \$(shell pwd)                                                  |

|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |

| #include \<linux/init.h\>                                             |
|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |
