|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/timer.h\>                                            |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/ip.h\>                                               |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/icmp.h\>                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<linux/if_ether.h\>                                         |
|                                                                       |
| MODULE_LICENSE(\"Dual BSD/GPL\");                                     |
|                                                                       |
| static struct net_device \*wf_dev;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| static struct timer_list rx_timer;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 打印数据包（调试用） \*/                                          |
|                                                                       |
| static void print_skb(const char \*dir, struct sk_buff \*skb)         |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| int i;                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| unsigned char \*data = skb-\>data;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"\[%s\] Packet %s (%u bytes): \\n\",                |
|                                                                       |
| wf_dev-\>name, dir, skb-\>len);                                       |
|                                                                       |
| for (i = 0; i \< skb-\>len && i \< 64; i++) { // 限制打印64字节       |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_CONT \"%02x \", data\[i\]);                               |
|                                                                       |
| if ((i + 1) % 16 == 0)                                                |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_CONT \"\\n\");                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| if (i % 16 != 0)                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_CONT \"\\n\");                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 接收数据包（模拟） \*/                                            |
|                                                                       |
| static void wf_rx_packet(struct net_device \*dev, unsigned char       |
| \*data, int len)                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| struct sk_buff \*skb;                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 分配 skb \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| skb = dev_alloc_skb(len + 2);                                         |
|                                                                       |
| if (!skb) {                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>stats.rx_dropped++;                                             |
|                                                                       |
| return;                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| skb_reserve(skb, 2); /\* 对齐 \*/                                     |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(skb_put(skb, len), data, len);                                 |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>dev = dev;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>protocol = eth_type_trans(skb, dev);                            |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>ip_summed = CHECKSUM_UNNECESSARY;                               |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 更新统计 \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>stats.rx_packets++;                                             |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>stats.rx_bytes += len;                                          |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 提交给上层 \*/                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| netif_rx(skb);                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 模拟接收定时器（用于测试） \*/                                    |
|                                                                       |
| static void rx_timer_callback(struct timer_list \*t)                  |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 示例：构造一个 ARP 回复包或简单的数据包 \*/                       |
|                                                                       |
| static unsigned char test_pkt\[\] = {                                 |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 目的MAC \*/ 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff,                   |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 源MAC \*/ 0x00, 0x11, 0x22, 0x33, 0x44, 0x55,                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 类型 \*/ 0x08, 0x00, /\* IPv4 \*/                                 |
|                                                                       |
| /\* IP数据 \*/ 0x45, 0x00, 0x00, 0x3c, 0x00, 0x00, 0x40, 0x00,        |
|                                                                       |
| 0x40, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0xc0, 0xa8, 0x01, 0x01,                       |
|                                                                       |
| 0xc0, 0xa8, 0x01, 0x02                                                |
|                                                                       |
| };                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| if (netif_running(wf_dev)) {                                          |
|                                                                       |
| wf_rx_packet(wf_dev, test_pkt, sizeof(test_pkt));                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"Simulated RX packet\\n\");                         |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 每5秒触发一次 \*/                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| mod_timer(&rx_timer, jiffies + msecs_to_jiffies(5000));               |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 发送 ARP 回复 \*/                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| static void send_arp_reply(struct net_device \*dev, struct sk_buff    |
| \*req_skb)                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| struct sk_buff \*skb;                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| struct ethhdr \*req_eth, \*reply_eth;                                 |
|                                                                       |
| struct arphdr \*req_arp, \*reply_arp;                                 |
|                                                                       |
| unsigned char \*arp_ptr;                                              |
|                                                                       |
| unsigned char sender_mac\[ETH_ALEN\];                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \_\_be32 sender_ip, target_ip;                                        |
|                                                                       |
| int hlen = LL_RESERVED_SPACE(dev);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| int arp_len = sizeof(struct arphdr) + (ETH_ALEN + 4) \* 2;            |
|                                                                       |
| req_eth = eth_hdr(req_skb);                                           |
|                                                                       |
| req_arp = (struct arphdr \*)req_skb-\>data;                           |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 解析请求 \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr = (unsigned char \*)(req_arp + 1);                            |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(sender_mac, arp_ptr, ETH_ALEN);                                |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += ETH_ALEN;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| sender_ip = \*(\_\_be32 \*)arp_ptr;                                   |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += 4;                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += ETH_ALEN; /\* 跳过目标 MAC \*/                             |
|                                                                       |
| target_ip = \*(\_\_be32 \*)arp_ptr;                                   |
|                                                                       |
| skb = alloc_skb(hlen + arp_len, GFP_ATOMIC);                          |
|                                                                       |
| if (!skb)                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| return;                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| skb_reserve(skb, hlen);                                               |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>dev = dev;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>protocol = htons(ETH_P_ARP);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>priority = 0;                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| reply_eth = (struct ethhdr \*)skb_put(skb, sizeof(struct ethhdr));    |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(reply_eth-\>h_dest, sender_mac, ETH_ALEN);                     |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(reply_eth-\>h_source, dev-\>dev_addr, ETH_ALEN);               |
|                                                                       |
| reply_eth-\>h_proto = htons(ETH_P_ARP);                               |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp = (struct arphdr \*)skb_put(skb, sizeof(struct arphdr));    |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp-\>ar_hrd = htons(ARPHRD_ETHER);                             |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp-\>ar_pro = htons(ETH_P_IP);                                 |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp-\>ar_hln = ETH_ALEN;                                        |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp-\>ar_pln = 4;                                               |
|                                                                       |
| reply_arp-\>ar_op = htons(ARPOP_REPLY);                               |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr = (unsigned char \*)(reply_arp + 1);                          |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(arp_ptr, dev-\>dev_addr, ETH_ALEN);                            |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += ETH_ALEN;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| \*(\_\_be32 \*)arp_ptr = target_ip;                                   |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += 4;                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(arp_ptr, sender_mac, ETH_ALEN);                                |
|                                                                       |
| arp_ptr += ETH_ALEN;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| \*(\_\_be32 \*)arp_ptr = sender_ip;                                   |
|                                                                       |
| dev_queue_xmit(skb);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: Sent ARP reply to %pI4\\n\", dev-\>name,       |
| &sender_ip);                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 发送 ICMP Echo Reply \*/                                          |
|                                                                       |
| static void send_icmp_reply(struct net_device \*dev, struct sk_buff   |
| \*req_skb)                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| struct sk_buff \*skb;                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| struct ethhdr \*req_eth, \*reply_eth;                                 |
|                                                                       |
| struct iphdr \*req_iph, \*reply_iph;                                  |
|                                                                       |
| struct icmphdr \*req_icmph, \*reply_icmph;                            |
|                                                                       |
| int hlen = LL_RESERVED_SPACE(dev);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| int ip_hdr_len, icmp_len;                                             |
|                                                                       |
| req_eth = eth_hdr(req_skb);                                           |
|                                                                       |
| req_iph = (struct iphdr \*)req_skb-\>data;                            |
|                                                                       |
| ip_hdr_len = req_iph-\>ihl \* 4;                                      |
|                                                                       |
| if (req_skb-\>len \< ip_hdr_len + sizeof(struct icmphdr))             |
|                                                                       |
| return;                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| req_icmph = (struct icmphdr \*)((unsigned char \*)req_iph +           |
| ip_hdr_len);                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| icmp_len = ntohs(req_iph-\>tot_len) - ip_hdr_len;                     |
|                                                                       |
| skb = alloc_skb(hlen + ip_hdr_len + icmp_len, GFP_ATOMIC);            |
|                                                                       |
| if (!skb)                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| return;                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| skb_reserve(skb, hlen);                                               |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>dev = dev;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| skb-\>protocol = htons(ETH_P_IP);                                     |
|                                                                       |
| reply_eth = (struct ethhdr \*)skb_put(skb, sizeof(struct ethhdr));    |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(reply_eth-\>h_dest, req_eth-\>h_source, ETH_ALEN);             |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(reply_eth-\>h_source, dev-\>dev_addr, ETH_ALEN);               |
|                                                                       |
| reply_eth-\>h_proto = htons(ETH_P_IP);                                |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph = (struct iphdr \*)skb_put(skb, sizeof(struct iphdr));      |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>version = 4;                                              |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>ihl = 5;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>tos = 0;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>tot_len = htons(sizeof(struct iphdr) + icmp_len);         |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>id = 0;                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>frag_off = 0;                                             |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>ttl = 64;                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>protocol = IPPROTO_ICMP;                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>saddr = req_iph-\>daddr;                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>daddr = req_iph-\>saddr;                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>check = 0;                                                |
|                                                                       |
| reply_iph-\>check = ip_fast_csum((unsigned char \*)reply_iph,         |
| reply_iph-\>ihl);                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| reply_icmph = (struct icmphdr \*)skb_put(skb, icmp_len);              |
|                                                                       |
| memcpy(reply_icmph, req_icmph, icmp_len);                             |
|                                                                       |
| reply_icmph-\>type = ICMP_ECHOREPLY;                                  |
|                                                                       |
| reply_icmph-\>checksum = 0;                                           |
|                                                                       |
| reply_icmph-\>checksum = csum_fold(csum_partial(reply_icmph,          |
| icmp_len, 0));                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| dev_queue_xmit(skb);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: Sent ICMP reply to %pI4\\n\", dev-\>name,      |
| &reply_iph-\>daddr);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 处理接收到的数据包 \*/                                            |
|                                                                       |
| static void handle_rx_packet(struct net_device \*dev, struct sk_buff  |
| \*skb)                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| struct ethhdr \*eth = eth_hdr(skb);                                   |
|                                                                       |
| struct arphdr \*arp;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| struct iphdr \*iph;                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| if (ntohs(eth-\>h_proto) == ETH_P_ARP) {                              |
|                                                                       |
| arp = (struct arphdr \*)skb-\>data;                                   |
|                                                                       |
| if (ntohs(arp-\>ar_op) == ARPOP_REQUEST) {                            |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: Received ARP request\\n\", dev-\>name);        |
|                                                                       |
| send_arp_reply(dev, skb);                                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| } else if (ntohs(eth-\>h_proto) == ETH_P_IP) {                        |
|                                                                       |
| iph = (struct iphdr \*)skb-\>data;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| if (iph-\>protocol == IPPROTO_ICMP) {                                 |
|                                                                       |
| struct icmphdr \*icmph = (struct icmphdr \*)((unsigned char \*)iph +  |
| iph-\>ihl \* 4);                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| if (icmph-\>type == ICMP_ECHO) {                                      |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: Received ICMP echo request\\n\", dev-\>name);  |
|                                                                       |
| send_icmp_reply(dev, skb);                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 发送数据包 \*/                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| static netdev_tx_t wf_start_xmit(struct sk_buff \*skb, struct         |
| net_device \*dev)                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| print_skb(\"TX\", skb);                                               |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 处理环回测试 - 处理接收到的数据包 \*/                             |
|                                                                       |
| handle_rx_packet(dev, skb);                                           |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 释放 skb \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| dev_consume_skb_any(skb);                                             |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 更新统计 \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>stats.tx_packets++;                                             |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>stats.tx_bytes += skb-\>len;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| return NETDEV_TX_OK;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 设备开启 \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| static int wf_open(struct net_device \*dev)                           |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: device opened\\n\", dev-\>name);               |
|                                                                       |
| netif_start_queue(dev);                                               |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 启动模拟接收定时器 \*/                                            |
|                                                                       |
| timer_setup(&rx_timer, rx_timer_callback, 0);                         |
|                                                                       |
| mod_timer(&rx_timer, jiffies + msecs_to_jiffies(1000));               |
|                                                                       |
| return 0;                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 设备关闭 \*/                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| static int wf_stop(struct net_device \*dev)                           |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"%s: device stopped\\n\", dev-\>name);              |
|                                                                       |
| netif_stop_queue(dev);                                                |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 停止定时器 \*/                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| del_timer_sync(&rx_timer);                                            |
|                                                                       |
| return 0;                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| static const struct net_device_ops wf_netdev_ops = {                  |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_start_xmit = wf_start_xmit,                                      |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_open = wf_open, /\* 添加开启回调 \*/                             |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_stop = wf_stop, /\* 添加关闭回调 \*/                             |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_validate_addr = eth_validate_addr,                               |
|                                                                       |
| .ndo_set_mac_address = eth_mac_addr,                                  |
|                                                                       |
| };                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| /\* 设备初始化 \*/                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| static void ethdev_setup(struct net_device \*dev)                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| ether_setup(dev);                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>netdev_ops = &wf_netdev_ops;                                    |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>flags \|= IFF_NOARP;                                            |
|                                                                       |
| dev-\>features \|= NETIF_F_HW_CSUM \| NETIF_F_RXCSUM;                 |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| static int \_\_init wf_init(void)                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| int ret;                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| wf_dev = alloc_netdev(0, \"eth-wf-%d\", NET_NAME_ENUM, ethdev_setup); |
|                                                                       |
| if (!wf_dev)                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| return -ENOMEM;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| eth_hw_addr_random(wf_dev);                                           |
|                                                                       |
| ret = register_netdev(wf_dev);                                        |
|                                                                       |
| if (ret) {                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| free_netdev(wf_dev);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| return ret;                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| printk(KERN_INFO \"Network device %s registered (MAC: %pM)\\n\",      |
|                                                                       |
| wf_dev-\>name, wf_dev-\>dev_addr);                                    |
|                                                                       |
| return 0;                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| static void \_\_exit wf_exit(void)                                    |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| unregister_netdev(wf_dev);                                            |
|                                                                       |
| free_netdev(wf_dev);                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| module_init(wf_init);                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| module_exit(wf_exit);                                                 |
+=======================================================================+

objdump-D-bbinary-mi386-Mintelabc.o\>abc.asm

  0x1               S_IXOTH (Others may execute)

  0x2               S_IWOTH (Others may write)

  [0x4]{.mark}      [S_IROTH (Others may read)]{.mark}

  0x8               S_IXGRP (Group members may execute)

  0x10              S_IWGRP (Group members may write)

  [0x20]{.mark}     [S_IRGRP (Group members may
                    read)]{.mark}

  0x800             S_ISUID (Set UID)

                    These are mutually-exclusive file types:

## Linux挂载rootfs过程

<https://tinylab.org/mnt-namespace/>

![](media/image100.emf)

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/linux-on-systems?topic=commands-qemu-image-command                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| #创建一个虚拟硬盘                                                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost home\]#  qemu-img create -f qcow2 disk.img 256M                                 |
|                                                                                                  |
| Formatting\'disk.img\',fmt=qcow2size=268435456encryption=offcluster_size=65536lazy_refcounts=off |
|                                                                                                  |
| #把虚拟硬盘全写成零                                                                              |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost home\]# dd if=/dev/zero of=disk.img bs=1M count=256                             |
|                                                                                                  |
| 256+0recordsin                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                  |
| 256+0recordsout                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| 268435456bytes (268 MB) copied, 0.111783 s, 2.4 GB/s                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
| #格式化虚拟硬盘                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost home\]# mkfs.ext4 -q disk.img                                                   |
|                                                                                                  |
| disk.imgisnotablockspecialdevice.                                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| Proceedanyway? (y,n)                                                                             |
|                                                                                                  |
| #挂载虚拟硬盘，可以编辑硬盘内容                                                                  |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost home\]# mount -t ext2 disk.img /home/abc                                        |
|                                                                                                  |
| #启动虚拟机                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost home\]# qemu-system-x86_64 -kernel ./linux-5.17/arch/x86/boot/bzImage -initrd   |
| /home/initramfs-wf.img -hda /home/disk.img -append console=ttyS0 --nographic                     |
|                                                                                                  |
| #这样不行                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost /\]# fdisk -l                                                                   |
|                                                                                                  |
| Disk /dev/loop0: 268 MB, 268435456 bytes, 524288 sectors                                         |
|                                                                                                  |
| Units = sectors of 1 \* 512 = 512 bytes                                                          |
|                                                                                                  |
| Sector size (logical/physical): 512 bytes / 512 bytes                                            |
|                                                                                                  |
| I/O size (minimum/optimal): 512 bytes / 512 bytes                                                |
|                                                                                                  |
| \[root@localhost /\]# mkfs.ext4 /dev/loop0                                                       |
|                                                                                                  |
| mke2fs 1.42.9 (28-Dec-2013)                                                                      |
|                                                                                                  |
| /dev/loop0 is mounted; will not make a filesystem here!                                          |

| #define CLONE_PIDFD 0x00001000  /\* set if a pidfd should be placed   |
| in parent \*/                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_PTRACE    0x00002000  /\* set if we want to let tracing |
| continue on the child too \*/                                         |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_VFORK 0x00004000  /\* set if the parent wants the child |
| to wake it up on mm_release \*/                                       |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_PARENT    0x00008000  /\* set if we want to have the    |
| same parent as the cloner \*/                                         |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_THREAD    0x00010000  /\* Same thread group? \*/        |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWNS 0x00020000  /\* New mount namespace group \*/     |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_SYSVSEM   0x00040000  /\* share system V SEM_UNDO       |
| semantics \*/                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_SETTLS    0x00080000  /\* create a new TLS for the      |
| child \*/                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_PARENT_SETTID 0x00100000  /\* set the TID in the parent |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID    0x00200000  /\* clear the TID in the  |
| child \*/                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_DETACHED      0x00400000  /\* Unused, ignored \*/       |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_UNTRACED      0x00800000  /\* set if the tracing        |
| process can\'t force CLONE_PTRACE on this clone                       |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_CHILD_SETTID  0x01000000  /\* set the TID in the child  |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWCGROUP     0x02000000  /\* New cgroup namespace \*/  |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWUTS        0x04000000  /\* New utsname namespace \*/ |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWIPC        0x08000000  /\* New ipc namespace \*/     |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWUSER       0x10000000  /\* New user namespace \*/    |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWPID        0x20000000  /\* New pid namespace \*/     |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_NEWNET        0x40000000  /\* New network namespace \*/ |
|                                                                       |
| #define CLONE_IO        0x80000000  /\* Clone io context \*/          |
+=======================================================================+
