## 创建个java服务

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \[root@iZbp1h35mcqj4b2tt9c5y2Z ralf\]# systemctl cat kps                                                              |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \# /etc/systemd/system/kps.service                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[Unit\]                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                       |
| Description=KsanatalkClient                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| After=network-online.target                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| Wants=network-online.target                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[Service\]                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| Type=simple                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| WorkingDirectory=/home/ralf                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| StandardOutput=file:/home/ralf/kps.log                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                       |
| StandardError=inherit                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                       |
| StartLimitInterval=3600                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                       |
| StartLimitBurst=10                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                       |
| ExecStart=/home/ralf/jdk-17.0.10/bin/java-Xms2g-Xmx4g-jar-Dserver.port=443-Dspring.config.location=/home/ralf/kps.yml |
|  /home/ralf/ksanatalk-client.jar                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                       |
| Restart=on-failure                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                       |
| RestartSec=120                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                       |
| KillMode=process#不要加，否则只杀死主进程                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[Install\]                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| WantedBy=multi-user.target                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \# 修改服务                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[root@iZbp1h35mcqj4b2tt9c5y2Z ralf\]# vim /etc/systemd/system/kps.service                                            |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \# 生效                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[root@iZbp1h35mcqj4b2tt9c5y2Z ralf\]# systemctl daemon-reload                                                        |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \# 启动服务                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \[root@iZbp1h35mcqj4b2tt9c5y2Z ralf\]# systemctl start kps                                                            |
|                                                                                                                       |
| \# centos7 版本要这样写                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                       |
| ExecStart=/bin/bash-c\"/data/app/wf/17.0.5-ms/bin/java -Xms2g -Xmx4g -jar -Dspring.config.location=/data/app/kps.yml  |
| /data/app/ksanatalk-client.jar \>\>/data/app/kps.log 2\>&1\"                                                          |
+=======================================================================================================================+

## agetty

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# \$TERM =\> /dev/tty1   115200,38400,9600=\>使用9600波率                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| console-getty.service                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty-o\'-p \-- \\\\u\'\--noclear\--keep-baud-115200,38400,9600\$TERM                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| getty@tty1.service                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty-o\'-p \-- \\\\u\'\--noclear-\$TERM                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| autovt@.service                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty-o\'-p \-- \\\\u\'\--noclear-\$TERM                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| serial-getty@.service                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty-o\'-p \-- \\\\u\'\--keep-baud115200,57600,38400,9600-\$TERM                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \[root@archlinux system\]# systemctl status getty@tty1.service                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# 登录显示（根据systemctl list-dependencies 查看对应的tty服务）                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \[root@archlinux system\]# systemctl cat <getty@tty1.service>                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# /usr/lib/systemd/system/getty@.service                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.1-or-later                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  This file is part of systemd.                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  systemd is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  under the terms of the GNU Lesser General Public License as published by                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  the Free Software Foundation; either version 2.1 of the License, or                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \#  (at your option) any later version.                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \[Unit\]                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Description=Gettyon%I                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Documentation=man:agetty(8) man:systemd-getty-generator(8)                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Documentation=https://0pointer.de/blog/projects/serial-console.html                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| After=systemd-user-sessions.serviceplymouth-quit-wait.servicegetty-pre.target                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| After=rc-local.service                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# If additional gettys are spawned during boot then we should make                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# sure that this is synchronized before getty.target, even though                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# getty.target didn\'t actually pull it in.                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Before=getty.target                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| IgnoreOnIsolate=yes                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# IgnoreOnIsolate causes issues with sulogin, if someone isolates                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# rescue.target or starts rescue.service from multi-user.target or                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# graphical.target.                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Conflicts=rescue.service                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Before=rescue.service                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# On systems without virtual consoles, don\'t start any getty. Note                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# that serial gettys are covered by serial-getty@.service, not this                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# unit.                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ConditionPathExists=/dev/tty0                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \[Service\]                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# the VT is cleared by TTYVTDisallocate                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# The \'-o\' option value tells agetty to replace \'login\' arguments with an                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# option to preserve environment (-p), followed by \'\--\' for safety, and then                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# the entered username.                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ExecStart=-/sbin/agetty-o\'-p \-- \\\\u\'\--noclear-\$TERM                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Type=idle                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| Restart=always                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| RestartSec=0                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| UtmpIdentifier=%I                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| StandardInput=tty                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| StandardOutput=tty                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| TTYPath=/dev/%I                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| TTYReset=yes                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| TTYVHangup=yes                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| TTYVTDisallocate=yes                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| IgnoreSIGPIPE=no                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| SendSIGHUP=yes                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ImportCredential=agetty.\*                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| ImportCredential=login.\*                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# Unset locale for the console getty since the console has problems                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \# displaying some internationalized messages.                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| UnsetEnvironment=LANGLANGUAGELC_CTYPELC_NUMERICLC_TIMELC_COLLATELC_MONETARYLC_MESSAGESLC_PAPERLC_NAMELC_ADDRESSLC_TELEPHONELC_MEASUREMENTLC_IDENTIFICATION |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| \[Install\]                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| WantedBy=getty.target                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                            |
| DefaultInstance=tty1                                                                                                                                       |
+============================================================================================================================================================+

| root@iZ8vbd72b0j247bul83lfeZ:\~#loginctllist-users                                                                                                                                                  |

| UIDUSER                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   0root                                                                                                                                                                                             |

|   Sender=:1.43  Destination=org.freedesktop.systemd1  Path=/org/freedesktop/systemd1/unit/getty_40tty1_2eservice  Interface=org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties  Member=GetAll                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|   UniqueName=:1.43                                                                                                                                                                                  |
