| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\manager.c                       |
|                                                                                    |
| staticvoidmanager_enumerate_perpetual(Manager \*m) {                               |
|                                                                                    |
|     for (UnitType c = 0; c \< \_UNIT_TYPE_MAX; c++) {                              |
|                                                                                    |
|             if (unit_vtable\[c\]-\>enumerate_perpetual)                            |
|                                                                                    |
|                     // 按类型分别调用不同的unit方法                                |
|                                                                                    |
|                     unit_vtable\[c\]-\>enumerate_perpetual(m);                     |
|                                                                                    |
|     }                                                                              |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\mount.c  比如执行 UNIT_MOUNT    |
| ,这个是必须加载的单元                                                              |
|                                                                                    |
| staticvoidmount_enumerate_perpetual(Manager \*m) {                                 |
|                                                                                    |
|         Unit \*u;                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
|         int r;                                                                     |
|                                                                                    |
|         //看看有没有                                                               |
|                                                                                    |
|         u = manager_get_unit(m, SPECIAL_ROOT_MOUNT);                               |
|                                                                                    |
|         if (!u) { // 没有新建一个Unit                                              |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_new_for_name(m, sizeof(Mount), SPECIAL_ROOT_MOUNT, &u);   |
|                                                                                    |
|         }                                                                          |
|                                                                                    |
|         u-\>perpetual = true;                                                      |
|                                                                                    |
|         MOUNT(u)-\>deserialized_state = MOUNT_MOUNTED;                             |
|                                                                                    |
|         //用于加载到链表 Unit 结构是个链表                                         |
|                                                                                    |
| u-\>manager-\>load_queue 指向的是当前单元  u-\>load_queue_next 指向的是下一个      |
|                                                                                    |
|         unit_add_to_load_queue(u);                                                 |
|                                                                                    |
|         unit_add_to_dbus_queue(u);                                                 |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\manager.c                       |
|                                                                                    |
| staticvoidmanager_enumerate(Manager \*m) {                                         |
|                                                                                    |
|         /\* Let\'s ask every type to load all units from disk/kernel that it might |
| know \*/                                                                           |
|                                                                                    |
|         for (UnitType c = 0; c \< \_UNIT_TYPE_MAX; c++) {                          |
|                                                                                    |
|                 if (unit_vtable\[c\]-\>enumerate)                                  |
|                                                                                    |
|                         unit_vtable\[c\]-\>enumerate(m);                           |
|                                                                                    |
|         }                                                                          |
|                                                                                    |
|         manager_dispatch_load_queue(m);                                            |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\manager.c这是个加载unit的分发器 |
|                                                                                    |
| unsignedmanager_dispatch_load_queue(Manager \*m) {                                 |
|                                                                                    |
|         Unit \*u;                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
|         while ((u = m-\>load_queue)) {                                             |
|                                                                                    |
|                 unit_load(u);                                                      |
|                                                                                    |
|                 n++;                                                               |
|                                                                                    |
|         }                                                                          |
|                                                                                    |
|         return n;                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\unit.c 加载队列                 |
|                                                                                    |
| voidunit_add_to_load_queue(Unit \*u) {                                             |
|                                                                                    |
|         LIST_PREPEND(load_queue, u-\>manager-\>load_queue, u);                     |
|                                                                                    |
|         u-\>in_load_queue = true;                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\basic\\list.h                         |
|                                                                                    |
| #define LIST_FIELDS(t,name) t \*name##\_next, \*name##\_prev                       |
|                                                                                    |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\systemd\\src\\core\\unit.c                          |
|                                                                                    |
| intunit_load(Unit \*u) {                                                           |
|                                                                                    |
|         int r;                                                                     |
|                                                                                    |
|         if (u-\>load_state == UNIT_LOADED) {                                       |
|                                                                                    |
|                 unit_add_to_target_deps_queue(u);                                  |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_add_slice_dependencies(u);                                |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_add_mount_dependencies(u);                                |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_add_oomd_dependencies(u);                                 |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_add_startup_units(u);                                     |
|                                                                                    |
|                 r = unit_validate_on_termination_job_modes(u);                     |
|                                                                                    |
|                 /\* We finished loading, let\'s ensure our parents recalculate the |
| members mask \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                                    |
|                 unit_invalidate_cgroup_members_masks(u);                           |
|                                                                                    |
|         }                                                                          |
|                                                                                    |
|         unit_add_to_dbus_queue(unit_follow_merge(u));                              |
|                                                                                    |
|         unit_add_to_gc_queue(u);                                                   |
|                                                                                    |
|         (void) manager_varlink_send_managed_oom_update(u);                         |
|                                                                                    |
|         return0;                                                                   |
|                                                                                    |
| }                                                                                  |

# Linux-pam 

#PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules) 可动态加载验证模块

#Linux-PAM (即linux可插入认证模块)
是一套共享库,使本地系统管理员可以随意选择程序的认证方式

代码地址:<https://github.com/linux-pam/linux-pam.git>

\# centos使用的是1.1.8版本

\[root@iZ8vbd72b0j247bul83lfeZ \~\]# rpm -qa\|grep pam

pam-1.1.8-23.el7.x86_64

\# pam的1.1.8版本

https://github.com/linux-pam/linux-pam/releases/tag/Linux-PAM-1_1_8

#ubuntu

/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_unix.so

#centos7

/usr/lib64/security/pam_unix.so

## 简单的调用pam_authenticate认证

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 源代码                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| #include\<security/pam_appl.h\>                                       |
|                                                                       |
| #include\<security/pam_misc.h\>                                       |
|                                                                       |
| #include\<stdio.h\>                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #include\<sys/types.h\>                                               |
|                                                                       |
| intmain(){                                                            |
|                                                                       |
|     structpam_convconv = { misc_conv, NULL };                         |
|                                                                       |
|     pam_handle_t \*pamh=NULL;                                         |
|                                                                       |
|     int retval = pam_start(\"check_user\", \"wf\", &conv, &pamh);     |
|                                                                       |
|     if (retval == PAM_SUCCESS)                                        |
|                                                                       |
|         retval = pam_authenticate(pamh, 0);                           |
|                                                                       |
|     printf(\"retval=%d\",retval);                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     return0;                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |

## pam_authenticate函数

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| /\* Authentication API\'s                                             |
|  D:\\linux\\linux-pam-master\\libpam\\include\\security\\pam_appl.h   |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| externintPAM_NONNULL((1))                                             |
|                                                                       |
| pam_authenticate(pam_handle_t \*pamh, int flags);                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-pam-master\\dynamic\\pam.c \*/                   |
|                                                                       |
| #define CONFIRM_PAM_FUNCTION(x, y, z, err) \\                         |
|                                                                       |
|     do { \\                                                           |
|                                                                       |
|         union { const void \*tpointer; y (\*fn) z ; } fptr; \\        |
|                                                                       |
|     fptr.tpointer=dlsym(libpam_h, #x); real\_##x=fptr.fn; \\          |
|                                                                       |
|     if (real\_##x== NULL) { \\                                        |
|                                                                       |
|         D((\"unable to resolve \'\"#x\"\': %s\", dlerror())); \\      |
|                                                                       |
|         return err; \\                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     } \\                                                              |
|                                                                       |
|     } while (0)                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| intpam_authenticate(pam_handle_t\*pamh, intflags)                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     staticint (\*real_pam_authenticate)(pam_handle_t\*, int);         |
|                                                                       |
|     CONFIRM_PAM_FUNCTION(pam_authenticate, int, (pam_handle_t \*,     |
| int),PAM_ABORT);                                                      |
|                                                                       |
|     returnreal_pam_authenticate(pamh, flags);                         |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-pam-master\\modules\\pam_unix\\pam_unix_auth.c   |
| \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| intpam_sm_authenticate(pam_handle_t\*pamh, intflags, intargc,         |
| constchar\*\*argv){                                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     retval = \_unix_verify_password(pamh, name, p, ctrl);             |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-pam-master\\modules\\pam_unix\\support.c \*/     |
|                                                                       |
| int_unix_verify_password(pam_handle_t\*pamh,                          |
| constchar\*name,constchar\*p, unsignedlonglongctrl){                  |
|                                                                       |
|     retval = get_pwd_hash(pamh, name, &pwd, &salt);                   |
|                                                                       |
|     retval = verify_pwd_hash(pamh, p, salt, off(UNIX\_\_NONULL,       |
| ctrl));                                                               |
|                                                                       |
|     pam_set_data(pamh, data_name, NULL, \_cleanup_failures);          |
|                                                                       |
|     return PAM_SUCCESS                                                |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* D:\\linux\\linux-pam-master\\modules\\pam_unix\\passverify.c \*/  |
|                                                                       |
| #define PAMH_ARG_DECL(fname, \...)   fname(\_\_VA_ARGS\_\_)           |
|                                                                       |
| #define PAMH_ARG(\...)           \_\_VA_ARGS\_\_                      |
|                                                                       |
| PAMH_ARG_DECL(int get_pwd_hash,constchar \*name, struct passwd        |
| \*\*pwd, char \*\*hash)                                               |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     int retval;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
|     structspwd\*spwdent = NULL;                                       |
|                                                                       |
|     retval = get_account_info(PAMH_ARG(name, pwd, &spwdent));         |
|                                                                       |
|     if (retval != PAM_SUCCESS) {                                      |
|                                                                       |
|         return retval;                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     }                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
|     if (spwdent)                                                      |
|                                                                       |
|         \*hash = x_strdup(spwdent-\>sp_pwdp);                         |
|                                                                       |
|     else                                                              |
|                                                                       |
|         \*hash = x_strdup((\*pwd)-\>pw_passwd);                       |
|                                                                       |
|     if (\*hash == NULL)                                               |
|                                                                       |
|         return PAM_BUF_ERR;                                           |
|                                                                       |
|     return PAM_SUCCESS;                                               |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |

|  Fromtheproject\'s root directory\...                                                                 |

|         Repeat these steps after each sync\...                                                        |
|                                                                                                       |
|         1) make (to produce generated .java source)                                                   |
|                                                                                                       |
|         2) development/tools/idegen/idegen.sh                                                         |
|                                                                                                       |
|         3) Open android.ipr in IntelliJ. If you already have the project open,                        |
|                                                                                                       |
|            hit the sync button in IntelliJ, and it wil automatically detect the                       |
|                                                                                                       |
|            updated configuration.                                                                     |
|                                                                                                       |
|         If you get unexpected compilation errors from IntelliJ, try running                           |
|                                                                                                       |

|                                                                                                       |
|         project changes significantly.                                                                |

| 3、配置JDK（使用prebuilts/jdk/\...目录下的JDK）                                                       |

## Android启动过程

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| //D:\\android-wf\\source\\frameworks\\base\\services\\core\\java\\com\\android\\server\\wm\\ActivityStartController.java |
|                                                                                                                          |
| voidstartHomeActivity(Intent intent, ActivityInfo aInfo, String reason, TaskDisplayArea taskDisplayArea) {               |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     final ActivityOptions options = ActivityOptions.makeBasic();                                                         |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     options.setLaunchWindowingMode(WINDOWING_MODE_FULLSCREEN);                                                           |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     if (!ActivityRecord.isResolverActivity(aInfo.name)) {                                                                |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // The resolver activity shouldn\'t be put in root home task because when the                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // foreground is standard type activity, the resolver activity should be put on the                              |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // top of current foreground instead of bring root home task to front.                                           |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         options.setLaunchActivityType(ACTIVITY_TYPE_HOME);                                                               |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     }                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     final int displayId = taskDisplayArea.getDisplayId();                                                                |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     options.setLaunchDisplayId(displayId);                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     options.setLaunchTaskDisplayArea(taskDisplayArea.mRemoteToken.toWindowContainerToken());                             |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     // The home activity will be started later, defer resuming to avoid unnecessary operations                           |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     // (e.g. start home recursively) when creating root home task.                                                       |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     mSupervisor.beginDeferResume();                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     final Task rootHomeTask;                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     try {                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // Make sure root home task exists on display area.                                                              |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         rootHomeTask = taskDisplayArea.getOrCreateRootHomeTask(ON_TOP);                                                  |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     } finally {                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         mSupervisor.endDeferResume();                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     }                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     mLastHomeActivityStartResult = obtainStarter(intent, \"startHomeActivity: \" + reason)                               |
|                                                                                                                          |
|             .setOutActivity(tmpOutRecord)                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                          |
|             .setCallingUid(0)                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                          |
|             .setActivityInfo(aInfo)                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                          |
|             .setActivityOptions(options.toBundle(),Binder.getCallingPid(), Binder.getCallingUid())                       |
|                                                                                                                          |
|             .execute();                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     mLastHomeActivityStartRecord = tmpOutRecord\[0\];                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     if (rootHomeTask.mInResumeTopActivity) {                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // If we are in resume section already, home activity will be initialized, but not                               |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // resumed (to avoid recursive resume) and will stay that way until something pokes it                           |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         // again. We need to schedule another resume.                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
|         mSupervisor.scheduleResumeTopActivities();                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                          |
|     }                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                          |
| }                                                                                                                        |
+==========================================================================================================================+

| #include \"include/core/SkBitmap.h\"                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkCanvas.h\"                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkColor.h\"                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkImageInfo.h\"                               |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkPixmap.h\"                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkStream.h\"                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/core/SkData.h\"                                    |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"include/encode/SkPngEncoder.h\"                            |
|                                                                       |
| int main() {                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| SkBitmap bitmap;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| bitmap.allocPixels(SkImageInfo::MakeN32Premul(256, 256));             |
|                                                                       |
| SkCanvas canvas(bitmap);                                              |
|                                                                       |
| canvas.clear(SK_ColorWHITE);//白色底                                  |
|                                                                       |
| SkPaint paint;                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| paint.setColor(SK_ColorBLUE);//蓝色画笔                               |
|                                                                       |
| canvas.drawCircle(128, 128, 100, paint);//画个圆                      |
|                                                                       |
| SkPixmap pixmap;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| bitmap.peekPixels(&pixmap);                                           |
|                                                                       |
| SkFILEWStream out(\"out.png\");//这是个方法，参数是个输出的文件名     |
|                                                                       |
| SkPngEncoder::Options options;                                        |
|                                                                       |
| options.fZLibLevel = 9;                                               |
|                                                                       |
| SkPngEncoder::Encode(&out, pixmap, options);                          |
|                                                                       |
| return0;                                                              |

## scp 和 rsync 的区别

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| scp是相当于复制，黏贴，如果有的话是覆盖，比较耗时间，不智能。         |
|                                                                       |
| rsync是复制，如果有重复的文件，会直接跳过，而且他自己的算法优化。     |
|                                                                       |
| scp是把文件全部复制过去，当文件修改后还是把所有文件复制过去，rsync    |
| 第一次是把所有文件同步过去，当文件修改后，只把修改的文件同步过去。    |
|                                                                       |
| scp -r /home/space/music/ username@ip:/home/root/others/music_new     |
|                                                                       |
| scp -P 30168 baseapibeijing.tar.zip web@10.241.108.172:/home/web/     |
| 5er5Ezof                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| rsync -avp mylog /home/                                               |
|                                                                       |
| rsync -av \--progress \${GET_dir}/\${Name}.jar                        |
| \${BAK_dir}/\${date}.\${Name}.jar                                     |
|                                                                       |
| rsync -avz YunFangDataApi-0.0.1-RELEASE.jar                           |
| web@10.30.248.101:/home/web/                                          |
+=======================================================================+

| 74. 由于.sh文件的格式为dos格式。而linux只能执行格式为unix格式的脚本。因为在dos/window下按一次回车键实际上输入的是"回车（CR)"和"换行（LF）"，而Linux/unix下按一次回车键只输入"换行（LF）"，所以修改的sh文件在每行都会多了一个CR，所以Linux下运行时就会报错找不到命令 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 75. 解决办法：vim打开shell文件后，:setff=unix设置                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

| 166. \# 增加交换分区，避免内存不足导致系统崩溃                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 167. fallocate -l 2G /swapfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 168. \# chmod 600 /swapfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 169.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 170. \# 创建交换分区并启用                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 171. mkswap /swapfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 172.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 173. \# 启用交换分区                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 174. swapon /swapfile                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## grep命令

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 匹配字符串取后3行，当前所有文件，输出到b.txt                                         |
|                                                                                         |
| grep-r-A3getEnquiryPrice  \*\>\>b.txt                                                   |
|                                                                                         |
| grep-C5foofile显示file文件里匹配foo字串那行以及上下5行                                  |
|                                                                                         |
| grep-B5foofile显示foo及前5行                                                            |
|                                                                                         |
| grep-A5foofile显示foo及后5行                                                            |
|                                                                                         |
| grep\'\^foo\$\'file  匹配只有foo的行                                                    |
|                                                                                         |
| egrep等同于grep--E                                                                      |
|                                                                                         |
| -n  :显示行号                                                                           |
|                                                                                         |
| -o  :只显示匹配的内容                                                                   |
|                                                                                         |
| -q  :静默模式，没有任何输出，得用\$?来判断执行成功没有，即有没有过滤到想要的内容        |
|                                                                                         |
| -l                                                                                      |
|  ：如果匹配成功，则只将文件名打印出来，失败则不打印，通常-rl一起用，grep-rl\'root\'/etc |
|                                                                                         |
| -c  :如果匹配成功，则将匹配到的行数打印出来                                             |
|                                                                                         |
| -E  :等于egrep，扩展                                                                    |
|                                                                                         |
| -i  ：忽略大小写                                                                        |
|                                                                                         |
| -v  :取反，不匹配                                                                       |
|                                                                                         |
| -w：匹配单词                                                                            |
+=========================================================================================+

## shell echo 字体颜色

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \[root@bqh-117 scripts\]# vim echoys.sh                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| #!/bin/sh                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| #定义颜色变量                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| RED=\'\\E\[1;31m\' \# 红                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| GREEN=\'\\E\[1;32m\' \# 绿                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| YELOW=\'\\E\[1;33m\' \# 黄                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| BLUE=\'\\E\[1;34m\' \# 蓝                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| PINK=\'\\E\[1;35m\' \# 粉红                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| RES=\'\\E\[0m\' \# 清除颜色                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| #用echo -e来调用                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| echo -e \"\${RED} this is red color \${RES}\"                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| echo -e \"\${GREEN} this is green color \${RES}\"                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| echo -e \"\${YELOW} this is red yelow \${RES}\"                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| echo -e \"\${BLUE} this is blue color \${RES}\"                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| echo -e \"\${PINK} this is pink color \${RES}\"                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                            |

## Linux 安装字体

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 在windows上C:\\Windows\\Fonts寻找需要的字体，或者从网上下载字体       |
|                                                                       |
| 比如宋体 = simsun.ttc                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| 复制到centos系统的/usr/share/fonts/dejavu                             |
|                                                                       |
| 执行fc-cache -fv把字体刷新到缓存                                      |
|                                                                       |
| Java 的进程需要重启才能生效                                           |
+=======================================================================+

## Maildrop问题

原因： /var/spool/postfix/maildrop 占用很大空间，导致服务器磁盘满

![](media/image120.png){width="6.076388888888889in"
height="2.3541666666666665in"}

删掉/var/spool/postfix/maildrop文件夹解决问题

| \# 缺证书                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                           |

|                                                                                                           |
| make\[1\]:\*\*\*Waitingforunfinishedjobs\....                                                             |
|                                                                                                           |
| \# 解决方案                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10877# .config 文件                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10878# Certificates for signature checking                                                                |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10879#                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10880CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY=\"certs/signing_key.pem\"                                                      |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10881CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY_TYPE_RSA=y                                                                     |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10882# CONFIG_MODULE_SIG_KEY_TYPE_ECDSA is not set                                                        |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10883CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYRING=y                                                                      |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10884CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS=\"debian/canonical-certs.pem\"  =\>CONFIG_SYSTEM_TRUSTED_KEYS=\"\"        |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10885CONFIG_SYSTEM_EXTRA_CERTIFICATE=y                                                                    |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10886CONFIG_SYSTEM_EXTRA_CERTIFICATE_SIZE=4096                                                            |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10887CONFIG_SECONDARY_TRUSTED_KEYRING=y                                                                   |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10888CONFIG_SYSTEM_BLACKLIST_KEYRING=y                                                                    |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10889CONFIG_SYSTEM_BLACKLIST_HASH_LIST=\"\"                                                               |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10890CONFIG_SYSTEM_REVOCATION_LIST=y                                                                      |
|                                                                                                           |
| 10891CONFIG_SYSTEM_REVOCATION_KEYS=\"debian/canonical-revoked-certs.pem\"                                 |
|  =\>CONFIG_SYSTEM_REVOCATION_KEYS=\"\"                                                                    |

## initramfs-linux.img内容

linux 先执行initramfs ，然后chroot 到真实的文件系统，并执行/init 脚本

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# initramfs-linux.img 是用zstd压缩的                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux boot\]# file initramfs-linux.img                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| initramfs-linux.img:Zstandardcompresseddata (v0.8+), Dictionary ID: None                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 解压缩为abc                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux wf\]# zstd -d initramfs-linux.img -o abc                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 解压缩后为cpio文件                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux wf\]# file abc                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| abc:ASCIIcpioarchive (SVR4 withnoCRC)                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 装个软件吧                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux wf\]# pacman -S cpio                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| #解压缩                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux wf\]# cpio -idmv \< abc                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[root@archlinux wf\]# ls                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| VERSION  bin  buildconfig   config  dev  etc  hooks  [init]{.mark}  init_functions                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| keymap.bin  liblib64  new_root  proc  run  sbin  sys  tmp  usr  var                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 在archlinux中当走完linux kernel 后，执行了initramfs-linux.img的init 脚本，然后通过 exec switch_root /new_root /sbin/init 来切换到systemd              |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 注意使用sz                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \[wf@archlinux bin\]\$ lrzsz-sz /home/wf/init                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| #init脚本                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| #!/bin/sh                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| mount-tprocproc/proc                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| mount-tsysfssysfs/sys                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| mdev-s                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| mount/dev/sda8/mnt                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| \# 这是切到systemd服务管理器                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| [execswitch_root/mnt/sbin/init]{.mark}                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| #Linux 内核提供了一种通过 /proc                                                                                                                          |
| 文件系统，在运行时访问内核内部数据结构、改变内核设置的机制，它以文件系统的方式为访问系统内核数据的操作提供接口，用户和应用程序可以通过proc得到系统的信息 |
|                                                                                                                                                          |
| mount-tprocproc/proc                                                                                                                                     |
+==========================================================================================================================================================+

## mount_setup函数

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| mount_setup() {                                                       |
|                                                                       |
|     mount-tprocproc/proc-onosuid,noexec,nodev                         |
|                                                                       |
|     mount-tsysfssys/sys-onosuid,noexec,nodev                          |
|                                                                       |
|     mount-tdevtmpfsdev/dev-omode=0755,nosuid                          |
|                                                                       |
|     mount-ttmpfsrun/run-onosuid,nodev,mode=0755                       |
|                                                                       |
|     mkdir-m755/run/initramfs                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     if \[ -e /sys/firmware/efi \]; then                               |
|                                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| mount-tefivarfsefivarfs/sys/firmware/efi/efivars-onosuid,nodev,noexec |
|                                                                       |
|     fi                                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     \# Setup /dev symlinks                                            |
|                                                                       |
|     if \[ -e /proc/kcore \]; then                                     |
|                                                                       |
|         ln-sfT/proc/kcore/dev/core                                    |
|                                                                       |
|     fi                                                                |
|                                                                       |
|     ln-sfT/proc/self/fd/dev/fd                                        |
|                                                                       |
|     ln-sfT/proc/self/fd/0/dev/stdin                                   |
|                                                                       |
|     ln-sfT/proc/self/fd/1/dev/stdout                                  |
|                                                                       |
|     ln-sfT/proc/self/fd/2/dev/stderr                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
