# Openssl

## 源码编译

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# TLS协议的官方文档                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc5246#section-7.4.7.1                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# openssl 下载                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| https://openssl-library.org/source/                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 下载源代码                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 编译前，准备配置                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ./Configure\--prefix=/usr/local/ssl\--openssldir=/usr/local/ssl\'-Wl,-rpath,\$(LIBRPATH)\'                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 进行编译                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| make                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 安装 , 也可以不安装，其实就是复制文件到指定的目录                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| makeinstall                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 默认的openssl                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/openssl#whereisopenssl                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| openssl:**/usr/bin/openssl**/usr/share/man/man1/openssl.1ssl.gz                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 直接创建软连接来覆盖掉之前的版本                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ln-sf/home/openssl/include/openssl/usr/include/openssl                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ln-sf/home/openssl/apps/openssl/usr/bin/openssl                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ln-sf/home/openssl/libssl.so.3/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libssl.so.3                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ln-sf/home/openssl/libcrypto.so.3/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcrypto.so.3                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 会出现错误                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Feb1801:36:47wf-virtual-machinesystemd-logind\[2763\]:/lib/systemd/systemd-logind:errorwhileloadingsharedlibraries:libcrypto.so.3:**cannotopensharedobjectfile:Nosuchfileordirectory** |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Feb1801:36:47wf-virtual-machinesystemd\[1\]:systemd-logind.service:Mainprocessexited,code=exited,status=127/n/a                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Feb1801:36:47wf-virtual-machinesystemd\[1\]:systemd-logind.service:Failedwithresult\'exit-code\'.                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Feb1801:36:47wf-virtual-machinesystemd\[1\]:FailedtostartUserLoginManagement.                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| \# 解决方案                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| rm-rf/usr/include/openssl                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| cp-r/home/openssl/include/openssl/usr/include/openssl                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |

| /\* 发送 Client Hello 关键函数                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \* Perform any work that needs to be done after sending a message from the                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \* client to the server.                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \* \\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\ssl\\statem\\statem_clnt.c                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|  \*/                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| WORK_STATE ossl_statem_client_post_work(SSL_CONNECTION \*s, WORK_STATE wst)                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| {                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     OSSL_STATEM \*st = &s-\>statem;                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     SSL \*ssl = SSL_CONNECTION_GET_SSL(s);                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     s-\>init_num = 0;                                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     case TLS_ST_CW_CLNT_HELLO:                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         if (s-\>early_data_state == SSL_EARLY_DATA_CONNECTING && s-\>max_early_data \>0) {                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             /\*                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|              \* We haven\'t selected TLSv1.3 yet so we don\'t call the change                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|              \* cipher state function associated with the SSL_METHOD. Instead                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|              \* we call tls13_change_cipher_state() directly.                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|              \*/                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             if ((s-\>options& SSL_OP_ENABLE_MIDDLEBOX_COMPAT) == 0) {                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                 if (!tls13_change_cipher_state(s, SSL3_CC_EARLY \| SSL3_CHANGE_CIPHER_CLIENT_WRITE)) {                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                     /\* SSLfatal() already called \*/                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                     return WORK_ERROR;                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                 }                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             }                                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         /\* else we\'re in compat mode so we delay flushing until after CCS \*/                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         [} elseif (!statem_flush(s)) {]{.mark}//这里刷一下就是让网卡把信息发出去                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             return WORK_MORE_A;                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         }                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         if (SSL_CONNECTION_IS_DTLS(s)) {                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             /\* Treat the next message as the first packet \*/                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|             s-\>first_packet = 1;                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         }                                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|         break;                                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     return WORK_FINISHED_CONTINUE;                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| }                                                                                                                                                                                      |

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\include\\openssl\\bio.h       |

| \# define BIO_do_handshake(b)                                         |

|                                                                       |
| //\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\ssl\\bio_ssl.c                |
|                                                                       |
| staticlongssl_ctrl(BIO \*b, intcmd, longnum, void \*ptr)              |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     longret = 1;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
|     \...\...                                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     switch (cmd) {                                                    |
|                                                                       |
|     case BIO_C_DO_STATE_MACHINE:                                      |
|                                                                       |
|         BIO_clear_retry_flags(b);                                     |
|                                                                       |
|         BIO_set_retry_reason(b, 0);                                   |
|                                                                       |
|         ret = (int)SSL_do_handshake(ssl);                             |
|                                                                       |
|         break;                                                        |
|                                                                       |
|     }                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
|     \...\...                                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     return ret;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |

| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
|     intret = 1;                                                       |
|                                                                       |
|     SSL_CONNECTION \*sc = SSL_CONNECTION_FROM_SSL(s);                 |
|                                                                       |
|     \...\...                                                          |
|                                                                       |
|     ret = sc-\>handshake_func(s);                                     |

## pms预主密钥

\#
在所有密钥生成之前，第一个生成的密钥就是pms，其他密钥都是从它派生出来的

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| /\* Derive secrets for ECDH/DH  \\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\ssl\\s3_lib.c    |
| \*/                                                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
| intssl_derive(SSL_CONNECTION \*s, EVP_PKEY \*privkey, EVP_PKEY \*pubkey, intgensecret) |
|                                                                                        |
| {                                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     intrv = 0;                                                                         |
|                                                                                        |
|     unsignedchar \*pms = NULL;                                                         |
|                                                                                        |
|     size_tpmslen = 0;                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     EVP_PKEY_CTX \*pctx;                                                               |
|                                                                                        |
|     SSL_CTX \*sctx = SSL_CONNECTION_GET_CTX(s);                                        |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 检查私钥和公钥是否为空                                                          |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (privkey == NULL \|\| pubkey == NULL) {                                         |
|                                                                                        |
|         SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, ERR_R_INTERNAL_ERROR);                      |
|                                                                                        |
|         return0;                                                                       |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 创建EVP_PKEY_CTX对象                                                            |
|                                                                                        |
|     pctx = EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_from_pkey(sctx-\>libctx, privkey, sctx-\>propq);           |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 初始化密钥派生，设置对等密钥，获取派生密钥长度                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (EVP_PKEY_derive_init(pctx) \<= 0                                               |
|                                                                                        |
|         \|\| EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer(pctx, pubkey) \<= 0                              |
|                                                                                        |
|         \|\| EVP_PKEY_derive(pctx, NULL, &pmslen) \<= 0) {                             |
|                                                                                        |
|         SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, ERR_R_INTERNAL_ERROR);                      |
|                                                                                        |
|         goto err;                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 如果是TLS1.3且私钥为DH，则设置DH填充                                            |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (SSL_CONNECTION_IS_TLS13(s) &&  EVP_PKEY_is_a(privkey, \"DH\"))                 |
|                                                                                        |
|         EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_pad(pctx, 1);                                              |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 分配内存保存预主密钥                                                            |
|                                                                                        |
|     pms = OPENSSL_malloc(pmslen);                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (pms == NULL) {                                                                 |
|                                                                                        |
|         SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, ERR_R_CRYPTO_LIB);                          |
|                                                                                        |
|         goto err;                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 执行密钥派生                                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (EVP_PKEY_derive(pctx, pms, &pmslen) \<= 0) {                                   |
|                                                                                        |
|         SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, ERR_R_INTERNAL_ERROR);                      |
|                                                                                        |
|         goto err;                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 如果需要生成密钥，则调用ssl_gensecret函数                                       |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (gensecret) {                                                                   |
|                                                                                        |
|         [rv = ssl_gensecret(s, pms, pmslen);]{.mark}                                   |
|                                                                                        |
|     } else {                                                                           |
|                                                                                        |
|         /\*保存预主密钥Save premaster secret \*/                                       |
|                                                                                        |
|         s-\>s3.tmp.pms = pms;                                                          |
|                                                                                        |
|         s-\>s3.tmp.pmslen = pmslen;                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
|         pms = NULL;                                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
|         rv = 1;                                                                        |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|  err:                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 释放预主密钥内存并清除其内容                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
|     OPENSSL_clear_free(pms, pmslen);                                                   |
|                                                                                        |
|     // 释放EVP_PKEY_CTX对象                                                            |
|                                                                                        |
|     EVP_PKEY_CTX_free(pctx);                                                           |
|                                                                                        |
|     returnrv;                                                                          |
|                                                                                        |
| }                                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
| /\*                                                                                    |
| 从给定的密钥上下文（EVP_PKEY_CTX）中派生出密钥的函数。openssl\\crypto\\evp\\exchange.c |
| \*/                                                                                    |
|                                                                                        |
| intEVP_PKEY_derive(EVP_PKEY_CTX \*ctx, unsignedchar \*key, size_t \*pkeylen)           |
|                                                                                        |
| {                                                                                      |
|                                                                                        |
|     intret;                                                                            |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (ctx-\>op.kex.algctx == NULL)                                                   |
|                                                                                        |
|         goto legacy;                                                                   |
|                                                                                        |
| //wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\providers\\implementations\\exchange\\ecx_exch.c   |
| =\>ecx_derive()                                                                        |
|                                                                                        |
|     [ret = ctx-\>op.kex.exchange-\>derive(ctx-\>op.kex.algctx, key, pkeylen, key !=    |
| NULL ? \*pkeylen : 0);]{.mark}                                                         |
|                                                                                        |
|     returnret;                                                                         |
|                                                                                        |
|  legacy:                                                                               |
|                                                                                        |
|     if (ctx-\>pmeth == NULL \|\| ctx-\>pmeth-\>derive == NULL) {                       |
|                                                                                        |
|         ERR_raise(ERR_LIB_EVP, EVP_R_OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_THIS_KEYTYPE);        |
|                                                                                        |
|         return -2;                                                                     |
|                                                                                        |
|     }                                                                                  |
|                                                                                        |
|     M_check_autoarg(ctx, key, pkeylen, EVP_F_EVP_PKEY_DERIVE)                          |
|                                                                                        |
|         returnctx-\>pmeth-\>derive(ctx, key, pkeylen);                                 |
|                                                                                        |
| }                                                                                      |

| // 服务器处理客户端传来的消息，包括密钥交换过程openssl\\ssl\\statem\\statem_srvr.c             |
|                                                                                                |
| MSG_PROCESS_RETURN ossl_statem_server_process_message(SSL_CONNECTION \*s, PACKET \*pkt)        |
|                                                                                                |
| {                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
|     OSSL_STATEM \*st = &s-\>statem;                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
|     switch (st-\>hand_state) {                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
|         default:                                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 不应该发生的情况 \*/                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, ERR_R_INTERNAL_ERROR);                              |
|                                                                                                |
|         return MSG_PROCESS_ERROR;                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_CLNT_HELLO:                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理客户端Hello消息 \*/                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_client_hello(s, pkt);                                                |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_END_OF_EARLY_DATA:                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理早期数据结束消息 \*/                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_end_of_early_data(s, pkt);                                           |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_CERT:                                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理客户端证书消息 \*/                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_client_certificate(s, pkt);                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_KEY_EXCH:                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理客户端密钥交换消息 \*/                                                         |
|                                                                                                |
|         [returntls_process_client_key_exchange(s, pkt);]{.mark}                                |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_CERT_VRFY:                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理证书验证消息 \*/                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_cert_verify(s, pkt);                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_CHANGE:                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理变更密码规范消息 \*/                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_change_cipher_spec(s, pkt);                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_FINISHED:                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理完成消息 \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_finished(s, pkt);                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
|         case TLS_ST_SR_KEY_UPDATE:                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         /\* 处理密钥更新消息 \*/                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
|         returntls_process_key_update(s, pkt);                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| //密钥交换\\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\ssl\\statem\\statem_srvr.c                     |
|                                                                                                |
| MSG_PROCESS_RETURN tls_process_client_key_exchange(SSL_CONNECTION \*s, PACKET \*pkt)           |
|                                                                                                |
| {                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
|     unsignedlong alg_k;                                                                        |
|                                                                                                |
|     alg_k = s-\>s3.tmp.new_cipher-\>algorithm_mkey;                                            |
|                                                                                                |
|     /\* PSK（预共享密钥）处理 For PSK parse and retrieve identity, obtain PSK key \*/          |
|                                                                                                |
|     if ((alg_k & SSL_PSK) && !tls_process_cke_psk_preamble(s, pkt)) { goto err;}               |
|                                                                                                |
|     /\* PSK handled by ssl_generate_master_secret \*/                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|     if (!ssl_generate_master_secret(s, NULL, 0, 0)) {goto err;                                 |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & (SSL_kRSA \| SSL_kRSAPSK)) {                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_rsa(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & (SSL_kDHE \| SSL_kDHEPSK)) {                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_dhe(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & (SSL_kECDHE \| SSL_kECDHEPSK)) {                                         |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_ecdhe(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                        |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & SSL_kSRP) {                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_srp(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & SSL_kGOST) {                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_gost(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                         |
|                                                                                                |
|     } elseif (alg_k & SSL_kGOST18) {                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
|         if (!tls_process_cke_gost18(s, pkt)) {goto err;}                                       |
|                                                                                                |
|     } else {                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
|     SSLfatal(s, SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR, SSL_R_UNKNOWN_CIPHER_TYPE);                             |
|                                                                                                |
|     goto err;                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                |
|     return MSG_PROCESS_CONTINUE_PROCESSING;                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| //生成握手密钥 \\\\wsl\$\\Ubuntu\\home\\wf\\openssl\\ssl\\tls13_enc.c                          |
|                                                                                                |
| inttls13_generate_handshake_secret(SSL_CONNECTION \*s,constunsignedchar                        |
| \*insecret,size_tinsecretlen)                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
| {                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| returntls13_generate_secret(s, ssl_handshake_md(s), s-\>early_secret, insecret, insecretlen,   |
|                                                                                                |
| (unsignedchar \*)&s-\>handshake_secret);                                                       |
|                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                              |
+================================================================================================+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **字段名称**                   **作用描述**
  ------------------------------ ----------------------------------------
  early_secret                   用于派生 0-RTT 数据的密钥。

  **handshake_secret**           **用于派生握手阶段的密钥。**

  master_secret                  用于派生应用数据的密钥。

  resumption_master_secret       用于派生会话恢复的密钥。

  client_finished_secret         用于计算客户端的 **Finished** 消息。

  server_finished_secret         用于计算服务器的 **Finished** 消息。

  server_finished_hash           存储服务器 **Finished** 消息的哈希值。

  handshake_traffic_hash         存储握手阶段消息的哈希值。

  client_app_traffic_secret      用于派生客户端应用数据的加密密钥。

  server_app_traffic_secret      用于派生服务器应用数据的加密密钥。

  exporter_master_secret         用于派生导出密钥（EKM）。

  early_exporter_master_secret   用于在早期数据阶段派生导出密钥。
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

## AES 加密例子

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| importjavax.crypto.Cipher                                                    |
|                                                                              |
| importjavax.crypto.KeyGenerator                                              |
|                                                                              |
| importjavax.crypto.SecretKey                                                 |
|                                                                              |
| classAESTool {                                                               |
|                                                                              |
|                                                                              |
|                                                                              |
|     staticvoidmain(String\[\] args) {                                        |
|                                                                              |
|         // 原始文本    Cipher Suite: TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384   |
| (0xc030)                                                                     |
|                                                                              |
|         String originalText = \"Hello, AES , I am wangfei!\"                 |
|                                                                              |
|         KeyGenerator keyGen = KeyGenerator.getInstance(\"AES\")              |
|                                                                              |
|         // 指定密钥长度为256位                                               |
|                                                                              |
|         keyGen.init(256)                                                     |
|                                                                              |
|         // 生成AES密钥                                                       |
|                                                                              |
|         SecretKey secretKey = keyGen.generateKey()                           |
|                                                                              |
|         println\"key: \"                                                     |
|                                                                              |
|         println secretKey.getEncoded().collect { String.format(\'%02X\', it) |
| }.join(\'\')                                                                 |
|                                                                              |
|         printlnBase64.getEncoder().encodeToString(secretKey.getEncoded())    |
|                                                                              |
|         //加密                                                               |
|                                                                              |
|         Cipher cipher = Cipher.getInstance(\"AES\")                          |
|                                                                              |
|         cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey)                          |
|                                                                              |
|         byte\[\] encryptedBytes = cipher.doFinal(originalText.getBytes())    |
|                                                                              |
|         println\"enc: \"                                                     |
|                                                                              |
|         println encryptedBytes.collect { String.format(\'%02X\', it)         |
| }.join(\'\')                                                                 |
|                                                                              |
|         printlnBase64.getEncoder().encodeToString(encryptedBytes)            |
|                                                                              |
|         //解密                                                               |
|                                                                              |
|         cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey)                          |
|                                                                              |
|         byte\[\] decryptedBytes = cipher.doFinal(encryptedBytes)             |
|                                                                              |
|         println\"dec: \"                                                     |
|                                                                              |
|         printlnnewString(decryptedBytes)                                     |
|                                                                              |
|     }                                                                        |
|                                                                              |
| }                                                                            |
|                                                                              |
