## 解读tuple表数据

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# This is a parse table file page Python script.                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| \# 页布局说明 https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/storage-page-layout.html                 |
|                                                                                                |
| import struct                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
| import re                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
| \# Press the green button in the gutter to run the script. Q 8 I 4 H 2 B 1                     |
|                                                                                                |
| if \_\_name\_\_ == \'\_\_main\_\_\':                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| columnArray = \[\'int8\',8,\'char\',8,\'int\',4\]                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| tupleDataPath = \"/Users/edy/24599\"                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| print(tupleDataPath)                                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| page_header_size = 24# 页头长度是24                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| with open(tupleDataPath,\"rb\") as f:                                                          |
|                                                                                                |
| data = f.read(8192)                                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| \# PageHeaderData Layout                                                                       |
|                                                                                                |
| pd_lsn,pd_checksum,pd_flags,pd_lower,pd_upper,pd_special,pd_pagesize_version,pd_prune_xid =    |
| struct.unpack_from(\"\<QHHHHHHI\", data, 0)                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| print(f\'PageHeaderData pd_lsn = \[\',hex(pd_lsn),\'\] pd_lower = \[\',hex(pd_lower),\'\]      |
| pd_upper = \[\',hex(pd_upper),\'\] pd_prune_xid = \[\',hex(pd_prune_xid),\'\]\')               |
|                                                                                                |
| print(\'\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--\') |
|                                                                                                |
| \# ItemPointer Layout                                                                          |
|                                                                                                |
| item_pointer = \[\]                                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| item_pointer1 = \[\]                                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| item_count = int((pd_lower - page_header_size) / 4) \# ItemPointer 每个4byte                   |
|                                                                                                |
| for i in range(item_count):                                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| offset = page_header_size + i \* 4                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
| item, = struct.unpack_from(\"\<I\", data, offset)                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| item1 = format(item, \'032b\')                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
| item_pointer += \[\[item1\[:15\], item1\[15:17\], item1\[17:\]\]\]                             |
|                                                                                                |
| item_pointer1 += \[\[hex(int(item1\[:15\], 2)), item1\[15:17\], hex(int(item1\[17:\], 2))\]\]  |
|                                                                                                |
| print(\'ItemPointer : \', item_pointer1)                                                       |
|                                                                                                |
| print(\'\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--\') |
|                                                                                                |
| \# HeapTupleHeaderData Layout                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
| dataLen = int((int(item_pointer\[0\]\[2\],2) - pd_upper) / (len(item_pointer)-1))              |
|                                                                                                |
| for item in item_pointer:                                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
| t_xmin,t_xmax,t_cid,t_xvac,t_ctid,t_ctid2,t_infomask2,t_infomask,t_hoff, =                     |
| struct.unpack_from(\"\<IIIIIHHHB\", data, int(item\[2\],2))                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| data1 = data\[int(item\[2\],2)+t_infomask2 :int(item\[2\],2)+t_infomask2+dataLen\]             |
|                                                                                                |
| row1 = \"\"                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| ii = 0                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                |
| for idx in range(0, len(columnArray), 2):                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
| if columnArray\[idx\] == \'int8\':                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
| row1 += f\"\\t{int.from_bytes(data1\[ii:ii+columnArray\[idx+1\]\], \'little\')}\"              |
|                                                                                                |
| if columnArray\[idx\] == \'char\':                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
| row1 += f\"\\t{re.sub(r\'\[\\x00-\\x1F\]+\',\'\',data1\[ii:ii + columnArray\[idx +             |
| 1\]\].decode(\"utf-8\"))}\"                                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| if columnArray\[idx\] == \'int\':                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| row1 += f\"\\t{int.from_bytes(data1\[ii:ii+columnArray\[idx+1\]\], \'little\')}\"              |
|                                                                                                |
| ii += columnArray\[idx+1\]                                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| row1 += f\"\\t{t_xmin}/{t_xmax}\"                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| print(f\'=\>\' , row1)                                                                         |
|                                                                                                |
| \# 输出 \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--                  |
|                                                                                                |
| /Users/edy/24599                                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
| PageHeaderData pd_lsn= \[ 0x19f46a000000000\]pd_lower= \[ 0x28\]pd_upper= \[                   |
| 0x1f40\]pd_prune_xid= \[ 0x302\]                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--            |
|                                                                                                |
| ItemPointer : \[\[\'0x2c\', \'01\',\'0x1fd0\'\], \[\'0x2c\', \'01\',\'0x1fa0\'\], \[\'0x2c\',  |
| \'01\',\'0x1f70\'\], \[\'0x2c\', \'01\',\'0x1f40\'\]\]                                         |
|                                                                                                |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--            |
|                                                                                                |
| =\>1aaaa11768/770                                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| =\>2bbb22769/0                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
| =\>1ccc11770/771                                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
| =\>1dddd11771/0                                                                                |

## Go语言解析tuple

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| package main                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| import (                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| \"encoding/binary\"                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| \"fmt\"                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| \"os\"                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| const (                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| PageSize = 8192                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| PageHeaderSize = 24                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| type PageHeader struct {                                              |
|                                                                       |
| PdLsn uint64                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| PdChecksum uint16                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| PdFlags uint16                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| PdLower uint16                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| PdUpper uint16                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| PdSpecial uint16                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| PdPagesizeVersion uint16                                              |
|                                                                       |
| PdPruneXid uint32                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| type ItemId struct {                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| LpOff uint16                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| LpFlags uint8                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| LpLen uint16                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| type HeapTupleHeader struct {                                         |
|                                                                       |
| TXmin uint32                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| TXmax uint32                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| TCid uint32                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| TCtidBlock uint32                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| TCtidPos uint16                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| TInfomask2 uint16                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| TInfomask uint16                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| THoff uint8                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| func parsePageHeader(data \[\]byte) PageHeader {                      |
|                                                                       |
| return PageHeader{                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| PdLsn: binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(data\[0:8\]),                       |
|                                                                       |
| PdChecksum: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[8:10\]),                 |
|                                                                       |
| PdFlags: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[10:12\]),                   |
|                                                                       |
| PdLower: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[12:14\]),                   |
|                                                                       |
| PdUpper: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[14:16\]),                   |
|                                                                       |
| PdSpecial: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[16:18\]),                 |
|                                                                       |
| PdPagesizeVersion: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[18:20\]),         |
|                                                                       |
| PdPruneXid: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data\[20:24\]),                |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| func parseItemId(v uint32) ItemId {                                   |
|                                                                       |
| return ItemId{                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| LpOff: uint16(v & 0x7FFF),                                            |
|                                                                       |
| LpFlags: uint8((v \>\> 15) & 0x03),                                   |
|                                                                       |
| LpLen: uint16((v \>\> 17) & 0x7FFF),                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| func parseTupleHeader(data \[\]byte, off int) HeapTupleHeader {       |
|                                                                       |
| return HeapTupleHeader{                                               |
|                                                                       |
| TXmin: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data\[off : off+4\]),               |
|                                                                       |
| TXmax: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data\[off+4 : off+8\]),             |
|                                                                       |
| TCid: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data\[off+8 : off+12\]),             |
|                                                                       |
| TCtidBlock: binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(data\[off+12 : off+16\]),      |
|                                                                       |
| TCtidPos: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[off+16 : off+18\]),        |
|                                                                       |
| TInfomask2: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[off+18 : off+20\]),      |
|                                                                       |
| TInfomask: binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(data\[off+20 : off+22\]),       |
|                                                                       |
| THoff: data\[off+22\],                                                |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| func main() {                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| //SELECT pg_relation_filepath(\'stu2\');                              |
|                                                                       |
| file := \"/var/lib/postgresql/16/main/base/16487/197479\"             |
|                                                                       |
| data, err := os.ReadFile(file)                                        |
|                                                                       |
| if err != nil {                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| panic(err)                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| page := data\[:PageSize\]                                             |
|                                                                       |
| header := parsePageHeader(page)                                       |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Printf(\"pd_lower=%d pd_upper=%d\\n\",                            |
|                                                                       |
| header.PdLower,                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| header.PdUpper)                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| itemCount := int(header.PdLower-PageHeaderSize) / 4                   |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Println(\"ItemCount =\", itemCount)                               |
|                                                                       |
| for i := 0; i \< itemCount; i++ {                                     |
|                                                                       |
| offset := PageHeaderSize + i\*4                                       |
|                                                                       |
| raw := binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(page\[offset : offset+4\])          |
|                                                                       |
| item := parseItemId(raw)                                              |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Printf(                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| \"Item\[%d\] off=%d flags=%d len=%d\\n\",                             |
|                                                                       |
| i,                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| item.LpOff,                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| item.LpFlags,                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| item.LpLen,                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| tuple := parseTupleHeader(page, int(item.LpOff))                      |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Printf(                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| \" xmin=%d xmax=%d hoff=%d\\n\",                                      |
|                                                                       |
| tuple.TXmin,                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| tuple.TXmax,                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| tuple.THoff,                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| dataStart := int(item.LpOff) + int(tuple.THoff)                       |
|                                                                       |
| tupleData := page\[dataStart : int(item.LpOff)+int(item.LpLen)\]      |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Printf(\" tuple_data=%x\\n\", tupleData)                          |
|                                                                       |
| id := binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(tupleData\[0:8\])                    |
|                                                                       |
| name := \"\"                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| age := \"\"                                                           |
|                                                                       |
| if len(tupleData) \> 10 {                                             |
|                                                                       |
| nameLen := int(tupleData\[8\] \>\> 1) + 9 -1                          |
|                                                                       |
| name = string(tupleData\[9: nameLen\])                                |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| if len(tupleData) \> 16 {                                             |
|                                                                       |
| age = string(tupleData\[16:\])                                        |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Printf(\" tuple_data= \[id:%d , name:%s ,age:%s\]\\n\",           |
| id,name,age)                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| fmt.Println(\"\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--\")        |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:\~/go_work# ls                           |
|                                                                       |
| abc abc.go go.mod                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 编译                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:\~/go_work# go build                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 执行                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:\~/go_work# ./abc                        |
|                                                                       |
| pd_lower=40 pd_upper=7992                                             |
|                                                                       |
| ItemCount = 4                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| Item\[0\] off=8152 flags=1 len=38                                     |
|                                                                       |
| xmin=206477 xmax=0 hoff=24                                            |
|                                                                       |
| tuple_data=01000000000000000d6d6d202020                               |
|                                                                       |
| tuple_data= \[id:1 , name:mm ,age:\]                                  |
|                                                                       |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--                         |
|                                                                       |
| Item\[1\] off=8112 flags=1 len=38                                     |
|                                                                       |
| xmin=206477 xmax=0 hoff=24                                            |
|                                                                       |
| tuple_data=02000000000000000d6665692020                               |
|                                                                       |
| tuple_data= \[id:2 , name:fei ,age:\]                                 |
+=======================================================================+

## 分析表的冗余度

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 创建个表                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| CREATE TABLEpublic.stu3                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| (                                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| idt bigint,                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| namet char(10),                                                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| PRIMARY KEY (idt)                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| );                                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 插入4条数据                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| insert intostu3(idt,namet) values(4,\'4\');                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 更新2次                                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| update stu3setnamet=\'hhh\'whereidt=2;                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 删1次                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| delete fromstu3whereidt=3;                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 看看数据                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| wf=# select \* from stu3;                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| idt \| namet                                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 1 \| 1                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 4 \| 4                                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 2 \| hhh                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| (3 rows)                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 查看表的统计信息                                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| wf=# select relid,relname,seq_tup_read,n_tup_ins,n_tup_upd,n_tup_del,n_live_tup,n_dead_tup from pg_stat_user_tables where relname = \'stu3\';                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| relid \| relname \| seq_tup_read \| n_tup_ins \| n_tup_upd \| n_tup_del \| n_live_tup \| n_dead_tup                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 32803 \| stu3 \| 14 \| 4 \| 2 \| 1 \| 3 \| 3                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| (1 row)                                                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |

| vacuum stu3;                                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                               |
| \# 查看stu3表的元数据                                                                                                                                                         |

## Wal日志分析

+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# wal(Write Ahead                                                                                                         |
| Log)基本可以保证内存和硬盘数据的一致性问题，原理就是日志是顺序写入硬盘，比数据文件的随机写入快10-30倍，而且没有复杂的逻辑. |
| WAL机制在7.1版本中首次被实现，用以减轻服务器崩溃的影响。它还是时间点恢复（Point-in-Time Recovery PIRT）与流复制（Streaming |
| Replication, SR）实现的基础                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| 00000001000000000000000A                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| │ │ └────── Segment Number（逻辑编号，8 字节十六进制）                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                            |
| │ └─────────────── Log ID（逻辑文件号）                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                            |
| └──────────────────────── Timeline ID                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 查看wal日志内容                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| /usr/local/pgsql/bin/pg_waldump /usr/local/pgsql/data/pg_wal/000000010000000000000001                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 只查Heap的日志，也就是操作表的Insert Update Delete等                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_waldump \--rmgr=Heap 000000010000000000000001                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 用sql查看wal                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| wf=# select \* from pg_ls_waldir();                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| name \| size \| modification                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--    |
|                                                                                                                            |
| 000000010000000000000001 \| 16777216 \| 2025-06-16 19:57:31-04                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| (1 row)                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 删了wal 一般起不来                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \$ /usr/local/pgsql/bin/pg_ctl-D/usr/local/pgsql/data-llogfilestart                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_ctl: anotherservermightberunning; trying tostartserveranyway                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| waiting forservertostart\....stoppedwaiting                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_ctl: couldnotstartserver                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 如果wal日志被删除了，但是数据文件正常                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/usr/local/pgsql/data# su-postgres                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \$ **/usr/local/pgsql/bin/pg_reset wal-f/usr/local/pgsql/data**                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| Write-ahead logreset                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 这样就从新生成了wal文件 ，新生成的wal 没有旧记录                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/usr/local/pgsql/data# tree pg_wal                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_wal                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                            |
| ├── 000000010000000000000008                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                            |
| ├── archive_status                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| └── summaries                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 然后正常启动                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                            |
| /usr/local/pgsql/bin/pg_ctl --D /usr/local/pgsql/data-llogfile start                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 如果想进入恢复模式，必须要/usr/local/pgsql/data有这个文件                                                               |
|                                                                                                                            |
| recovery.signal                                                                                                            |

| The overall layout of an XLOG record is:                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| Fixed-size header (XLogRecord struct)                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecordBlockHeader struct                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecordBlockHeader struct                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \...                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecordDataHeader\[Short\|Long\] struct                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                            |
| block data                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                            |
| block data                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \...                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| main data                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# src/include/catalog/pg_control.h                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| typedefstruct CheckPoint                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecPtr redo; /\* next RecPtr available when we began to                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \* create CheckPoint (i.e. REDO start point) \*/                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TimeLineID ThisTimeLineID; /\* current TLI \*/                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TimeLineID PrevTimeLineID; /\* previous TLI, if this record begins a new                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \* timeline (equals ThisTimeLineID otherwise) \*/                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| bool fullPageWrites; /\* current full_page_writes \*/                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| int wal_level; /\* current wal_level \*/                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| FullTransactionId nextXid; /\* next free transaction ID \*/                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| Oid nextOid; /\* next free OID \*/                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| MultiXactId nextMulti; /\* next free MultiXactId \*/                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| MultiXactOffset nextMultiOffset; /\* next free MultiXact offset \*/                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TransactionId oldestXid; /\* cluster-wide minimum datfrozenxid \*/                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| Oid oldestXidDB; /\* database with minimum datfrozenxid \*/                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| MultiXactId oldestMulti; /\* cluster-wide minimum datminmxid \*/                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| Oid oldestMultiDB; /\* database with minimum datminmxid \*/                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_time_t time; /\* time stamp of checkpoint \*/                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TransactionId oldestCommitTsXid; /\* oldest Xid with valid commit                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \* timestamp \*/                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TransactionId newestCommitTsXid; /\* newest Xid with valid commit                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \* timestamp \*/                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TransactionId oldestActiveXid;                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| } CheckPoint;                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# src/include/access/xlogrecord.h                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| typedefstruct XLogRecord                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| uint32 xl_tot_len; /\* total len of entire record \*/                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| TransactionId xl_xid; /\* xact id \*/                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecPtr xl_prev; /\* ptr to previous record in log \*/                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                            |
| uint8 xl_info; /\* flag bits, see below \*/                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                            |
| RmgrId xl_rmid; /\* resource manager for this record \*/                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| /\* 2 bytes of padding here, initialize to zero \*/                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| pg_crc32c xl_crc; /\* CRC for this record \*/                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                            |
| /\* XLogRecordBlockHeaders and XLogRecordDataHeader follow, no padding \*/                                                 |
|                                                                                                                            |
| } XLogRecord;                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \# 这是一个wal链src/include/access/xlog_internal.h                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| typedefstruct XLogRecData                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| struct XLogRecData \*next; /\* next struct in chain, or NULL \*/                                                           |
|                                                                                                                            |
| char \*data; /\* start of rmgr data to include \*/                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| uint32 len; /\* length of rmgr data to include \*/                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| } XLogRecData;                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| /\* 插入wal日志的关键函数 src/backend/access/transam/xloginsert.c\*/                                                       |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecPtr XLogInsert(RmgrId rmid, uint8 info)                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogRecPtr EndPos;                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| do                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                            |
| {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                            |
| \...\...                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                            |
| //组装wal日志                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                            |
| rdt = XLogRecordAssemble(rmid, info, RedoRecPtr, doPageWrites, &fpw_lsn, &num_fpi, &topxid_included);                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| //执行插入                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                            |
| EndPos = XLogInsertRecord(rdt, fpw_lsn, curinsert_flags, num_fpi, topxid_included);                                        |
|                                                                                                                            |
| } while (EndPos == InvalidXLogRecPtr);                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                            |
| //重制插入状态                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| XLogResetInsertion();                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                            |
| return EndPos;                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                            |
| }                                                                                                                          |

## 支持SIGKILL停止

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| /\* pg_waldump 是如何接收Ctrl + C 停止命令的 \*/                      |
|                                                                       |
| staticvolatile sig_atomic_t time_to_stop = false;                     |
|                                                                       |
| staticvoid sigint_handler(SIGNAL_ARGS)                                |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| time_to_stop = true;                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| int main(int argc, char \*\*argv)                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \...\...                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| for (;;)                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| if (time_to_stop)                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| {                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| /\* We\'ve been Ctrl-C\'ed, so leave \*/                              |
|                                                                       |
| break;                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| if (time_to_stop)                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| exit(0);                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
+=======================================================================+

## Flex+bison例子（逻辑有问题版）

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 3个文件                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/c/a# ls                            |
|                                                                       |
| a1.y a2.lmain.c                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| \# bison文件\-\-\-\--执行命令： bison -d a1.y                         |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/c/a# cata1.y                       |
|                                                                       |
| %{                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<stdio.h\>                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<stdlib.h\>                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| int yylex(void);                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| void yyerror(constchar \*s);                                          |
|                                                                       |
| %}                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| %token NUMBER                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| %left \'+\'\'-\'                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| %left \'\*\'\'/\'                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| %%                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| expr:                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| expr \'+\' expr { printf(\"%d\\n\", \$1 + \$3); }                     |
|                                                                       |
| \| expr \'-\' expr { printf(\"%d\\n\", \$1 - \$3); }                  |
|                                                                       |
| \| expr \'\*\' expr { printf(\"%d\\n\", \$1 \* \$3); }                |
|                                                                       |
| \| expr \'/\' expr { printf(\"%d\\n\", \$1 / \$3); }                  |
|                                                                       |
| \| \'(\' expr \')\' { \$\$ = \$2; }                                   |
|                                                                       |
| \| NUMBER { \$\$ = \$1; }                                             |
|                                                                       |
| ;                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| %%                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| void yyerror(constchar \*s) {                                         |
|                                                                       |
| fprintf(stderr, \"Error: %s\\n\", s);                                 |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# flex 文件命令： flex a2.l                                          |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/c/a# cata2.l                       |
|                                                                       |
| %{                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| #include \"a1.tab.h\"                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| %}                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| %%                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| \[0-9\]+ { yylval = atoi(yytext); return NUMBER; }                    |
|                                                                       |
| \[ \\t\\n\]+ ; // 忽略空白符                                          |
|                                                                       |
| . { return yytext\[0\]; }                                             |
|                                                                       |
| %%                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| int yywrap() {                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| return1;                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# main主函数                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/c/a# cat main.c                    |
|                                                                       |
| #include \<stdio.h\>                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| int yyparse(void);                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| int main() {                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| printf(\"Enter an expression:\\n\");                                  |
|                                                                       |
| yyparse();                                                            |
|                                                                       |
| return0;                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| #编译成可执行a.out                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| gcc a1.tab.c lex.yy.c main.c -lfl                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 执行效果，逻辑不对                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| root@iZbp17lww5bvfkvuyyqc0yZ:/home/c/a# ./a.out                       |
|                                                                       |
| Enter anexpression:                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| 1+2+3                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| 3                                                                     |
