## 安装数据库

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| *#yum安装*                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| \[root@localhost \~\]#yum install postgresql-server                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| *#初始化数据库*                                                                                |
|                                                                                                |
| \[root@localhost \~\]# postgresql-setup initdb                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
| Initializing database \... OK                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
| *#安装13版本*                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                |
| https://www.postgresql.org/download/linux/redhat/                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| *\# Install the repository RPM:*                                                               |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo dnf install -y                                                                            |
| <https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-8-x86_64/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.n> |
|                                                                                                |
| oarch.rpm                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
| *\# Disable the built-in PostgreSQL module:*                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo dnf -qy module disable postgresql                                                         |
|                                                                                                |
| *\# Install PostgreSQL:*                                                                       |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo dnf install -y postgresql13-server                                                        |
|                                                                                                |
| *\# Optionally initialize the database and enable automatic start:*                            |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo /usr/pgsql-13/bin/postgresql-13-setup initdb                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo systemctl enable postgresql-13                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| sudo systemctl start postgresql-13                                                             |
|                                                                                                |
| *#修改配置文件，启动远程可以访问*                                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| /var/lib/pgsql/data/postgresql.conf                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| /var/lib/pgsql/13/data/postgresql.conf                                                         |
|                                                                                                |
| listen_addresses = \'\*\'*\# what IP address(es) to listen on;*                                |
|                                                                                                |
| ![](media/image228.png){width="5.982638888888889in" height="0.7479166666666667in"}             |
|                                                                                                |
| *#修改/var/lib/pgsql/data/pg_hba.conf配置文件，远程访问*                                       |
|                                                                                                |
| */var/lib/pgsql/13/data/pg_hba.conf*                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| host all all 0.0.0.0/0 md5                                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| *#启动服务*                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                |
| \[root@localhost \~\]# systemctl start postgresql                                              |
|                                                                                                |
| *#切到postgres用户环境，才能本地登陆*                                                          |
|                                                                                                |
| \[root@localhost \~\]# sudo su -- postgres                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| *#本地登陆命令*                                                                                |
|                                                                                                |
| psql                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                |
| ![](media/image229.png){width="6.373611111111111in" height="3.173611111111111in"}              |
|                                                                                                |
| *#创建用户名和密码*                                                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| create user kps with password \'uMFJ72VUL1BMdRIx\';                                            |
|                                                                                                |
| *#授权*                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                |
| grant all privileges on database kps to kps;                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
| *#执行设置密码*                                                                                |
|                                                                                                |
| postgres-# \\password postgres                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
| 输入新的密码：                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                |
| 再次键入：                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| ![](media/image230.png){width="2.4784722222222224in" height="0.6868055555555556in"}            |
|                                                                                                |
| *#外网连接postgresql成功*                                                                      |
|                                                                                                |
| ![](media/image231.png){width="3.3424201662292212in" height="3.9739643482064744in"}            |
|                                                                                                |
| select postgis_version() ; \-- 查询gis版本                                                     |
|                                                                                                |
| create database kps_development---创建数据库                                                   |
|                                                                                                |
| CREATE EXTENSION postgis;\--执行创建postgis，这样就创建了个spatial_ref_sys表                   |
|                                                                                                |
| \--复制库的时候，不要同步spatial_ref_sys表                                                     |

## Ubuntu安装pg16

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 下面的命令会更新系统的软件包列表，这样就可以获取到最新的软件包信息了                               |
|                                                                                                       |
| sudo apt install -y curl ca-certificates                                                              |
|                                                                                                       |
| \#                                                                                                    |
| 下面的命令会安装postgresql-common包，这个包包含了一些公共的工具和脚本，用于管理postgresql的安装和配置 |
|                                                                                                       |
| sudo apt install -y postgresql-common                                                                 |
|                                                                                                       |
| \# 下面的命令会添加postgresql的官方软件源，这样就可以安装到最新版本的postgresql16了                   |
|                                                                                                       |
| sudo /usr/share/postgresql-common/pgdg/apt.postgresql.org.sh                                          |
|                                                                                                       |
| \# 更新                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                       |
| sudo apt update                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                       |
| \# 安装postgresql16                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                       |
| sudo apt install -y postgresql-16                                                                     |
+=======================================================================================================+

## 常用sql总结

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| *#级联删除--当多个表相互引用关联的时候*                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| truncate table workflow_instance cascade                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| <https://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.1/sql-truncate.html>                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 复制表                                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| create table component_bak as select \* from component                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查询进程                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select \* from pg_stat_activity                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \--查询死锁                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select \* from pg_locks;                                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- kill id                                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| SELECT pg_terminate_backend(34321432)                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \--直接查询后kill掉                                                                                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_terminate_backend(pid) from pg_stat_activity where datname =\'kps_dev\'                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| altertable collateral add column tax_method varchar(32);                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| altertable community_information add column market_score  float8;                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| altertable city add column territory_id int8;                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| altertable workflow add column metadata text;                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 修改数据库名称                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| alter database kps_test renameto dev_ru;                                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查询数据库大小                                                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_database.datname, pg_database_size(pg_database.datname) ASsizefrom pg_database;                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 列出kps_dev 数据库大小                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(\'kps_dev\'));                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查看索引大小                                                                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(\'account_name_index\'));                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查看account表所有索引占用空间                                                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_size_pretty(pg_indexes_size(\'account\'));                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查看表大小                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(\'collateral\'));                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 查看所有表大小，并排序                                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(relid)) from pg_stat_user_tables                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| where schemaname=\'public\'order by pg_relation_size(relid) desc;                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 备份数据库                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| createdatabasekps_bakwith template kps;                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| CREATEDATABASEkps1ENCODING UTF8 LC_COLLATE \'zh_CN.UTF-8\' LC_CTYPE \'zh_CN.UTF-8\';                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 截取字符串                                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select id,name,substring(script,position(\'kps.url.aliOssUrl\'in script)-10,100),script from component where script like\'%kps.url.aliOssUrl\")?%\'                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 根据id 修改script字段值                                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| update component set script = component_bak.script from component_bak where component.id =component_bak.id                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| https://dev-en.kamalasoftware.com/layout/index?layoutType=fit                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| https://dev-en.kamalasoftware.com/account/show/3009?layoutName=fitTogetherLaout                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 把所有的panel 都放到fitTogetherLaout页面                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| insert into layout_panel(id,version,display_order,layout_id,name,type,panel_id)                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select NEXTVAL(\'hibernate_sequence\') as id, 0asversion,1as display_order,4764as layour_id,left(description,16) asname,\'View\'astype,id as panel_id from panel            |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \-- 把按钮button插入好                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| INSERT INTO panel_button (id, version, display_order,  button_id, layout_panel_id)                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select NEXTVAL(\'hibernate_sequence\') as id,0asversion,1as display_order,button_id,layout_panel_id from (                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select a.button_id,b.panel_id  from panel_button  a left join layout_panel b on a.layout_panel_id=b.id                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ) a left join (                                                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| select id as layout_panel_id,panel_id from layout_panel where layout_id=4764                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ) b on a.panel_id=b.panel_id where layout_panel_id is not null                                                                                                              |

| \-- 生成删除语句（不自动执行）                                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| SELECT                                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| \'ALTER TABLE \' \|\| tc.table_name \|\| \' DROP CONSTRAINT \' \|\| tc.constraint_name \|\| \';\' AS drop_statement                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| FROM information_schema.table_constraints AS tc                                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage AS ccu                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name                                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |
| WHERE tc.constraint_type = \'FOREIGN KEY\'                                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                                                             |

## dblink远程复制表

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 先在B数据库 （A -\> B）安装插件                                    |
|                                                                       |
| CREATE EXTENSION dblink;                                              |
|                                                                       |
| \# 创建表                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| CREATE TABLE community_information                                    |
|                                                                       |
| (                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| id bigint NOT NULL,                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| version bigint NOT NULL                                               |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \# 然后sql执行远程copy                                                |
|                                                                       |
| INSERT INTO public.community_information                              |
|                                                                       |
| (id, version)                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| SELECT \*                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| FROM dblink(                                                          |
|                                                                       |
| \'host=101.126.157.201 port=7908 dbname=oem3_kps user=wangfei         |
| password=ozS6lai9BMyJKgWExR\',                                        |
|                                                                       |
| \-- SELECT 列列表                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \'SELECT id, version FROM community_information\'                     |
|                                                                       |
| ) AS t (                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| \-- 生成 dblink 的 AS 类型定义                                        |
|                                                                       |
| id bigint, version bigint                                             |
|                                                                       |
| );                                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| \# 生成 SELECT 列列表                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| SELECT string_agg(column_name, \', \' ORDER BY ordinal_position)      |
|                                                                       |
| FROM information_schema.columns                                       |
|                                                                       |
| WHERE table_name = \'community_information\'                          |
|                                                                       |
| AND table_schema = \'public\';                                        |
|                                                                       |
| \# 生成 dblink 的 AS 类型定义                                         |
|                                                                       |
| SELECT string_agg(                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| column_name \|\| \' \' \|\|                                           |
|                                                                       |
| CASE                                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'character varying\' THEN \'varchar(\' \|\|         |
| character_maximum_length \|\| \')\'                                   |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'timestamp without time zone\' THEN \'timestamp\'   |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'double precision\' THEN \'double precision\'       |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'bigint\' THEN \'bigint\'                           |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'integer\' THEN \'integer\'                         |
|                                                                       |
| WHEN data_type = \'boolean\' THEN \'boolean\'                         |
|                                                                       |
| ELSE data_type                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| END,                                                                  |
|                                                                       |
| \', \' ORDER BY ordinal_position                                      |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| FROM information_schema.columns                                       |
|                                                                       |
| WHERE table_name = \'community_information\'                          |
|                                                                       |
| AND table_schema = \'public\';                                        |
+=======================================================================+

## Pgvector向量计算

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \# 安装pgvector插件                                                                               |
|                                                                                                   |
| apt list \|grep postgresql-16-pgvector                                                            |
|                                                                                                   |
| apt install postgresql-16-pgvector                                                                |
|                                                                                                   |
| postgresql-16-pgvector/noble,now 0.6.0-1 amd64 \[installed\]                                      |
|                                                                                                   |
| \# 对应的postgresql数据库也就安装上了                                                             |
|                                                                                                   |
| postgresql-16/noble-updates,noble-security,now 16.11-0ubuntu0.24.04.1 amd64                       |
| \[installed,automatic\]                                                                           |
|                                                                                                   |
| \# 启动数据库                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                   |
| systemctl status postgresql                                                                       |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 创建pgvector扩展                                                                              |
|                                                                                                   |
| create extension vector;                                                                          |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 查看是否安装成功                                                                              |
|                                                                                                   |
| SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = \'vector\';                          |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 创建个地址字段转换成向量数组的函数                                                            |
|                                                                                                   |
| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION generate_address_vector_v2(address_text TEXT)                          |
|                                                                                                   |
| DECLARE                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                   |
| vec FLOAT8\[\] := array_fill(0.0, ARRAY\[300\]);                                                  |
|                                                                                                   |
| BEGIN                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 方法1：基于字符的one-hot编码（前100维）                                                       |
|                                                                                                   |
| FOR j IN 1..LEAST(length(address_text), 100) LOOP                                                 |
|                                                                                                   |
| vec\[j\] := ascii(substring(address_text FROM j FOR 1)) / 255.0;                                  |
|                                                                                                   |
| END LOOP;                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                   |
| RETURN vec::vector;                                                                               |
|                                                                                                   |
| END;                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 创建表                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                   |
| CREATE TABLE address_wf (                                                                         |
|                                                                                                   |
| id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,                                                                            |
|                                                                                                   |
| address text,                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                   |
| vec VECTOR(300)                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                   |
| )                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 插入个数据                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                   |
| insert into address_wf (address,vec)                                                              |
|                                                                                                   |
| values(\'北京市海淀区中关村大街27号\',array_fill(0.1, ARRAY\[300\])::vector(300));                |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 相当于给向量vec字段赋值                                                                       |
|                                                                                                   |
| update address_wf set vec=generate_address_vector_v2(address);                                    |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-- 可以根据余弦相似度匹配数据， 相当于高级like                                                   |
|                                                                                                   |
| wf=# select address,(1- (vec \<=\> generate_address_vector_v2(\'北京市海淀区中关村大街27号\')))   |
| as sim from address_wf;                                                                           |
|                                                                                                   |
| address \| sim                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                   |
| \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--+\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-- |
|                                                                                                   |
| 北京市西城区车公庄大街9号院 \| [0.9442081289977143]{.mark}                                        |
|                                                                                                   |
| 这个sim 值和cosine_similarity算法结果是一样的                                                     |
+===================================================================================================+

## 余弦相似度算法实现

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| import torch                                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| import torch.nn.functional as F                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \# 两个 batch 的向量，下面俩组值是用generate_address_vector_v2函数copy过来的                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| x1 = torch.tensor(\[                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \[83.41569,78.98039,94.37647,138.0353,88.14902,83.55294,143.96078,81.74117,94.88628,89.50196,136.87451,0.22352941,84.29412,150.97255\]     |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \])                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| x2 = torch.tensor(\[                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \[83.41569,78.98039,94.37647,109.89412,110.18039,83.55294,78.48235,81.76863,103.721565,89.50196,136.87451,0.19607843,0.21568628,84.29412\] |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \])                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \# 方式 1：直接用 cosine similarity                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| cos_sim = F.cosine_similarity(x1, x2, dim=1)                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| print(\"cosine similarity:\", cos_sim)                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| \# 结果输出为                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                            |
| cosine similarity: [tensor(\[0.9442\])]{.mark}                                                                                             |
+============================================================================================================================================+

## 自动对比表的新增列

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \-- 在正式库kps执行sql ，组成where 条件 (table_name=\'button\' and    |
| column_name not in (\'id\'))                                          |
|                                                                       |
| selectconcat(\'(table_name=\'\'button\'\' and column_name not in      |
| (\'\'\',string_agg(column_name,\'\'\',\'\'\'),\'\'\')) or \') as cc   |
|                                                                       |
| from information_schema.columns where table_catalog=\'kps\'and        |
| table_schema=\'public\'and table_name=\'button\'                      |
|                                                                       |
| union all                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| selectconcat(\'(table_name=\'\'flex_object\'\' and column_name not in |
| (\'\'\',string_agg(column_name,\'\'\',\'\'\'),\'\'\')) or \') as cc   |
|                                                                       |
| from information_schema.columns where table_catalog=\'kps\'and        |
| table_schema=\'public\'and table_name=\'flex_object\'                 |
|                                                                       |
| \-- 在测试库把上面的结果放到下面的where条件                           |
|                                                                       |
| select concat(\'alter table \',table_name,\' add \',column_name,\'    |
| \',udt_name,\';\') as sqlstr                                          |
|                                                                       |
| from information_schema.columns where table_catalog=\'kps_dev\'and    |
| table_schema=\'public\'                                               |
|                                                                       |
| and (                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| \-- where 条件开始                                                    |
|                                                                       |
| (table_name=\'button\'and column_name notin (\'id\',\'version\')) or  |
|                                                                       |
| (table_name=\'flex_object\'and column_name notin                      |
| (\'id\',\'version\',\'created_date\'))                                |
|                                                                       |
| \-- where 结束                                                        |
|                                                                       |
| )                                                                     |
|                                                                       |
| \-- 查询结果自动组装个sql                                             |
|                                                                       |
| alter table flex_object add init_user_field bool;                     |

## 触发器

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| DELIMITER \$\$                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                           |
| DROPTRIGGER/\*!50032 IF EXISTS \*/\`yf_score\`.\`total_score_tiger\`\$\$                                  |
|                                                                                                           |
| CREATE                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                           |
|     /\*!50017 DEFINER = \'dbroot\'@\'%\' \*/                                                              |
|                                                                                                           |
|     TRIGGER \`total_score_tiger\`BEFOREUPDATEON\`s_scoreresult\`                                          |
|                                                                                                           |
|     for each rowBEGIN                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare lianghua Int;                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare cityOrder Int;                                                                                |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare distinctOrder Int;                                                                            |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare buildYear Int;                                                                                |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare houseType Int;                                                                                |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare managementFee Int;                                                                            |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare houseNature Int;                                                                              |
|                                                                                                           |
|     declare\`position\`Int;                                                                               |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set lianghua = (SELECT paramValue AS lianghua FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE paramName=\'量价稳定性\');  |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set cityOrder = (SELECT paramValue AS cityOrder FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE                           |
| paramName=\'城市房价百分位\');                                                                            |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set distinctOrder = (SELECT paramValue AS distinctOrder FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE                   |
| paramName=\'行政区房价百分位\');                                                                          |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set buildYear = (SELECT paramValue AS buildYear FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE paramName=\'建成年代\');  |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set houseType = (SELECT paramValue AS houseType FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE paramName=\'物业类型\');  |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set managementFee = (SELECT paramValue AS managementFee FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE                   |
| paramName=\'物业费\');                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set houseNature = (SELECT paramValue AS houseNature FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE                       |
| paramName=\'房屋性质\');                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                           |
|     set\`position\` = (SELECT paramValue AS\`position\`FROM\`s_scoreparam\`  WHERE paramName=\'行政区\'); |
|                                                                                                           |
| SET new.marketScore = (new.lianghuaScore2\*lianghua + (1-new.cityOrderScore)\*cityOrder +                 |
| (1-new.distinctOrderScore)\*distinctOrder )/(lianghua+cityOrder+distinctOrder)\*100                       |
|                                                                                                           |
|      ,new.entityScore = (new.buildYearScore\*buildYear + new.houseTypeScore\*houseType +                  |
| new.managementFeeScore\*managementFee +                                                                   |
| new.houseNatureScore\*houseNature)/(buildYear+houseType+managementFee+houseNature)\*100                   |
|                                                                                                           |
|      ,new.positionScore = new.positionScore \* 100                                                        |
|                                                                                                           |
|      ,new.totalScore = new.marketScore \* (lianghua+cityOrder+distinctOrder)/100 +                        |
| new.positionScore\*\`position\`/100+new.entityScore\*(buildYear+houseType+managementFee+houseNature)/100; |
|                                                                                                           |
|     END;                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                           |
| \$\$                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                           |
| DELIMITER ;                                                                                               |

# Postgis空间数据

参考文档：<http://postgis.net/docs/manual-2.3/ST_DWithin.html>

<https://docs.jboss.org/hibernate/orm/current/userguide/html_single/Hibernate_User_Guide.html#basic-explicit>

<https://postgis.net/docs/manual-3.0/postgis_installation.html#idm757>

https://people.planetpostgresql.org/devrim/index.php?/archives/107-Installing-PostGIS-3.1-and-PostgreSQL-13-on-CentOS-8.html

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| *#安装postgis*                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                         |
| <https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-7-x86_64/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm> |
|                                                                                                         |
| 用rpm --ivh pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm安装yum源                                                 |
|                                                                                                         |
| *#安装, 注意postgis和postgresql的版本关系*                                                              |
|                                                                                                         |
| yum install postgis30_13.x86_64                                                                         |
|                                                                                                         |
| apt install postgis postgresql-14-postgis-3                                                             |
|                                                                                                         |
| *#缺包的话，请 yum install epel-release*                                                                |
|                                                                                                         |
| *#查看是不是安装完成*                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                         |
| yum list installed \|grep postgis                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| *\-- 查询gis版本*                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| select postgis_version() ;                                                                              |
|                                                                                                         |
| *---创建数据库*                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                         |
| create database kps_development                                                                         |
|                                                                                                         |
| *\--执行创建postgis，这样就创建了个spatial_ref_sys表*                                                   |
|                                                                                                         |
| *\--复制库的时候，不要同步spatial_ref_sys表*                                                            |
|                                                                                                         |
| CREATE EXTENSION postgis;                                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| *\# 引入依赖包*                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                         |
| implementation group: \'org.hibernate\', name: \'hibernate-spatial\', version: \'5.6.+\'                |
|                                                                                                         |
| *\# 创建表实体*                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                         |
| import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Geometry                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| class Poi                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| {                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| Geometry coordinate                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                         |
| static constraints = {                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                         |
| coordinate nullable: true, blank: true                                                                  |
|                                                                                                         |
| }                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| }                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| *#使用dwithin 比较俩个距离*                                                                             |
|                                                                                                         |
| CommunityCoordinate.findAll(\"select p from CommunityCoordinate                                         |
| p where dwithin(coordinate,:pp,2000,true) = true\"                                                      |
|                                                                                                         |
| ,\[pp:\])                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| \# 安装arm64版本的postgis                                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| yuminstall-y\--nogpgcheckpostgis34_14.aarch64                                                           |
|                                                                                                         |
| yumlocalinstall\--nogpgcheckpostgis-3.0.2-2.mga8.x86_64.rpm                                             |
|                                                                                                         |
| \# 可能需要安装的依赖列表                                                                               |
|                                                                                                         |
| boost-serialization-1.75.0-8.el9.aarch64.rpm                                                            |
|                                                                                                         |
| gmp-c++-6.2.0-13.el9.aarch64.rpm                                                                        |
|                                                                                                         |
| jbigkit-libs-2.1-23.el9.aarch64.rpm                                                                     |
|                                                                                                         |
| lib64gdal27-3.1.3-7.2.mga8.aarch64.rpm                                                                  |
|                                                                                                         |
| libgfortran-11.4.1-3.el9.alma.1.aarch64.rpm                                                             |
|                                                                                                         |
| libtiff-4.4.0-12.el9.aarch64.rpm                                                                        |
|                                                                                                         |
| libwebp-1.2.0-8.el9_3.aarch64.rpm                                                                       |
|                                                                                                         |
| libxslt-1.1.34-9.el9.aarch64.rpm                                                                        |
|                                                                                                         |
| pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm                                                                      |
|                                                                                                         |
| postgis-3.0.2-2.mga8.aarch64.rpm                                                                        |
|                                                                                                         |
| postgresql-server-devel-13.14-1.el9_3.aarch64.rpm                                                       |

# java NIO

<http://tutorials.jenkov.com/java-nio/pipe.html>

**NIO使用java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocateDirect()方法分配内存，每次分配内存都会调用操作系统函数os::malloc()，所以，分配的内存是本机的内存而不是Java堆上的内存；**

http://ifeve.com/java-nio-all/

Java NIO 由以下几个核心部分组成：

- Channels 数据流（通道）

- Buffers 缓冲区

- Selectors 选择器

Selector允许单线程处理多个
Channel。如果你的应用打开了多个连接（通道），但每个连接的流量都很低，使用Selector就会很方便

Selector（选择器）是Java
NIO中能够检测一到多个NIO通道，并能够知晓通道是否为诸如读写事件做好准备的组件。这样，一个单独的线程可以管理多个channel，从而管理多个网络连接。

![http://ifeve.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/overview-selectors.png](media/image237.png){width="4.25in"
height="3.3645833333333335in"}

虽然Java NIO 中除此之外还有很多类和组件，但在我看来，Channel，Buffer 和
Selector
构成了核心的API。其它组件，如Pipe和FileLock，只不过是与三个核心组件共同使用的工具类。

![http://ifeve.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/overview-channels-buffers1.png](media/image238.png){width="3.5208333333333335in"
height="2.40625in"}

以下是Java NIO里关键的Buffer实现：

- ByteBuffer

- CharBuffer

- DoubleBuffer

- FloatBuffer

- IntBuffer

- LongBuffer

- ShortBuffer

这些是Java NIO中最重要的通道(Channel)的实现：

- FileChannel 从文件中读写数据。

- DatagramChannel 能通过UDP读写网络中的数据。

- SocketChannel 能通过TCP读写网络中的数据。

- ServerSocketChannel可以监听新进来的TCP连接，像Web服务器那样。对每一个新进来的连接都会创建一个SocketChannel。

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Pipe pipe = Pipe.*open*();\
  Pipe.SinkChannel sinkChannel = pipe.sink();\
  String newData = \"王飞New String to write to file\...\" +
  System.currentTimeMillis();\
  **byte** \[\] bb = newData.getBytes();\
  ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.*allocate*(bb.**length**);\
  buf.clear();\
  buf.put(newData.getBytes());\
  buf.flip();\
  **while**(buf.hasRemaining()) {\
  sinkChannel.write(buf);\
  }\
  Pipe.SourceChannel sourceChannel = pipe.source();\
  ByteBuffer buf1 = ByteBuffer.*allocate*(bb.**length**);*\*
  **int** bytesRead = sourceChannel.read(buf1);\
  **byte** \[\] bbb = buf1.array();*\*
  System.***out***.println(**\"\\n\"**+**new** String(bbb));
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

# Netty

https://github.com/iwannarun/JavaWiki/blob/master/Netty%E5%AE%9E%E6%88%98.pdf

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **public static void** nettyStart() **throws** InterruptedException {\
  **int** port =8012;\
  *// NioEventLoopGroup是处理I/O操作的多线程事件循环\*
  EventLoopGroup group = **new** NioEventLoopGroup();\
  **try** {\
  *// ServerBootstrap是一个用于设置服务器的引导类。\*
  ServerBootstrap b = **new** ServerBootstrap();\
  b.group(group)\
  .channel(NioServerSocketChannel.**class**) *//
  使用NioServerSocketChannel类，用于实例化新的通道以接受传入连接\*
  .localAddress(**new** InetSocketAddress(port)) *//
  设置服务器监听端口号\*
  .childHandler(**new** ChannelInitializer\<SocketChannel\>() {\
  \@Override\
  **public void** initChannel(SocketChannel ch) **throws** Exception {\
  ch.pipeline().addLast(**new** EchoServerHandler()); *// 添加请求处理\*
  }\
  });\
  *// 绑定到端口和启动服务器\*
  ChannelFuture f = b.bind().sync();\
  System.***out***.println(App.**class**.getName() +\
  **\" started and listening for connections on \"** +
  f.channel().localAddress());\
  f.channel().closeFuture().sync();\
  } **finally** {\
  group.shutdownGracefully().sync();\
  }\
  }
