## Git

当你修改了文件，别人也修改了并提交了，这个时候进行pull的时候就会冲突

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 通过git                                                                      |
| stash将工作区恢复到上次提交的内容，同时备份本地所做的修改，之后就可以正常git |
| pull了，git pull完成后，执行git stash                                        |
| pop将之前本地做的修改应用到当前工作区。                                      |
|                                                                              |
| git stash                                                                    |
|                                                                              |
| git pull                                                                     |
|                                                                              |
| git stash pop                                                                |
+==============================================================================+

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| git pull origin master                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                              |
| 将本地的冲突文件冲掉，不仅需要reset到MERGE-HEAD或者HEAD,还需要\--hard。没有后面的hard，不会冲掉本地工作区。只会冲掉stage区。 |
|                                                                                                                              |
| git reset \--hard FETCH_HEAD                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                              |
| 克隆项目到本地                                                                                                               |
|                                                                                                                              |
| git clone http://git.work.yunfangdata.com/ShuiWu/taxRateAnalysis.git                                                         |
|                                                                                                                              |
| git reset \--hard 139dcfaa558e3276b30b6b2e5cbbb9c00bbdca96                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                              |
| 如果出现错误回退，或者回退版本多了，未push的代码没了                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                              |
| git reflog                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                              |
| 找到以前的commit id 再进行git reset --hard \*\*\*\*\*\*                                                                      |
+==============================================================================================================================+

参考：https://git-scm.com/book/zh/v1/Git-内部原理

四个重要的文件或目录：HEAD及 index文件，objects 及refs 目录。这些是 Git
的核心部分。objects 目录存储所有数据内容，refs 目录存储指向数据 (分支)
的提交对象的指针，HEAD 文件指向当前分支，index 文件保存了暂存区域信息。

git fetch和git pull的概念

![http://kmknkk.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/image/git.jpg](media/image239.jpeg){width="7.0875in"
height="2.011078302712161in"}

git
fetch是将远程主机的最新内容拉到本地，用户在检查了以后决定是否合并到工作本机分支中

而git pull则是将远程主机的最新内容拉下来后直接合并，即：git pull = git
fetch + git merge，这样可能会产生冲突，需要手动解决。

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| git branch //查看本地所有分支                                         |
|                                                                       |
| git branch -r //查看远程所有分支                                      |
|                                                                       |
| git branch -a //查看本地和远程的所有分支                              |
|                                                                       |
| git branch \<branchname\> //新建分支                                  |
|                                                                       |
| git branch -d \<branchname\> //删除本地分支                           |
|                                                                       |
| git branch -d -r \<branchname\>                                       |
| //删除远程分支，删除后还需推送到服务器                                |
|                                                                       |
| git push origin:\<branchname\> //删除后推送至服务器                   |
|                                                                       |
| git branch -m \<oldbranch\>\<newbranch\> //重命名本地分支             |
|                                                                       |
| git fetch origin master                                               |
|                                                                       |
| git pull origin master                                                |
|                                                                       |
| git fetch origin master //从远程主机的master分支拉取最新内容          |
|                                                                       |
| git merge FETCH_HEAD //将拉取下来的最新内容合并到当前所在的分支中     |
|                                                                       |
| git fetch orgin master //将远程仓库的master分支下载到本地当前branch中 |
|                                                                       |
| git log -p master ..origin/master                                     |
| //比较本地的master分支和origin/master分支的差别                       |
|                                                                       |
| git merge origin/master //进行合并                                    |
|                                                                       |
| git fetch origin master:tmp                                           |
| //从远程仓库master分支获取最新，在本地建立tmp分支                     |
|                                                                       |
| git diff tmp //將當前分支和tmp進行對比                                |
|                                                                       |
| git merge tmp //合并tmp分支到当前分支                                 |
|                                                                       |
| git checkout xxx.txt                                                  |
| //修改了本地文件，没提交，提示不能pull，如果放弃本地修改              |
|                                                                       |
| git push --force//强制推送到远程服务器，比如回退版本后进行强制回退    |
+=======================================================================+

## jenkins

![](media/image246.png){width="7.0875in" height="3.7246030183727035in"}

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 修改Jenkins配置文件                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| \# 打开配置文件                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| vim /etc/sysconfig/jenkins                                            |
|                                                                       |
| \# 修改\$JENKINS_USER，并去掉当前行注释                               |
|                                                                       |
| \$JENKINS_USER=\"root\"                                               |
|                                                                       |
| 修改Jenkins相关文件夹用户权限                                         |
|                                                                       |
| chown -R root:root /var/lib/jenkins                                   |
|                                                                       |
| chown -R root:root /var/cache/jenkins                                 |
|                                                                       |
| chown -R root:root /var/log/jenkins                                   |
|                                                                       |
| 重启Jenkins服务并检查运行Jenkins的用户是否已经切换为root              |
|                                                                       |
| \# 重启Jenkins（若是其他方式安装的jenkins则重启方式略不同）           |
|                                                                       |
| service jenkins restart                                               |
|                                                                       |
| \# 查看Jenkins进程所属用户                                            |
|                                                                       |
| ps -ef \| grep jenkins                                                |
|                                                                       |
| \# 若显示为root用户，则表示修改完成                                   |
|                                                                       |
| /var/lib/jenkins/workspace/taxRateAnalysis/target                     |

  **public class** FtpGate{\
  **public** Result ftpDownLoad(String ftpCmd,String fileName){\
  \
  Result res =**new** Result();\
  setFtp(ftpCmd);*//\"SFTP://wf:wf@192.168.6.951/abc\");\*
  **try** {\
  **sfg**.downLoad(**remoteDir** + fileName);\
  }**catch**(Exception e){\
  e.printStackTrace();\
  String faile =e.getMessage();\
  **if**(e **instanceof** MessageHandlingException){\
  res.fail(**false**,11,**\"本地文件已经存在\"**);\
  }\
  **else if**(e **instanceof** IllegalStateException){\
  res.fail(**false**,12,**\"服务器连接失败\"**);\
  }\
  **else if**(e **instanceof** MessagingException){\
  res.fail(**false**,13,**\"FTP服务器的文件或目录不存在\"**);\
  }\
  \
  }\
  \
  **return** res;\
  }\
  \
  **public** Result ftpUpLoad(String ftpCmd,String localFile,String RemoteFileName){\
  Result res =**new** Result();\
  setFtp(ftpCmd);\
  **try** {\
  File ff =**new** File(localFile);\
  **boolean** f = ff.exists();\
  \
  **if**(!f){\
  res.fail(**false**,21,**\"本地文件不存在\"**);\
  }\
  **if**(f){\
  **sfg**.upLoadFtpServer(ff,**remoteDir**+RemoteFileName);\
  }\
  \
  }**catch**(Exception e){\
  e.printStackTrace();\
  String faile =e.getMessage();\
  \
  **if**(e **instanceof** IllegalStateException){\
  res.fail(**false**,22,**\"服务器连接失败\"**);\
  }\
  **else if**(e **instanceof** MessageDeliveryException){\
  res.fail(**false**,23,**\"FTP服务器目录权限失败\"**);\
  }\
  \
  }\
  **return** res;\
  }\
  \
  \
  }\
  \
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 返回结果\
  \*/\*
  **public class** Result{\
  **boolean suc** = **true**;\
  String **msg** = **\"成功\"**;\
  **int code** =0;\
  \
  **void** fail(**boolean** suc,**int** code,String msg){\
  **this**.**suc**=suc;\
  **this**.**code**=code;\
  **this**.**msg**=msg;\
  }\
  \
  **public boolean** isSuc() {\
  **return suc**;\
  }\
  **public** String getMsg() {\
  **return msg**;\
  }\
  \
  }\
  \
  \
  }

## Grails脚手架

|                                                                       |
| #安装grails                                                           |
| ，可用sdkman进行安装，也可手动下载zip包然后解压设置环境变量           |
|                                                                       |
| sdk install grails 4.0.9                                              |
|                                                                       |
| #创建一个项目                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| grails  create-app  helloworld                                        |
|                                                                       |
| #进入创建的项目目录，执行grails                                       |
|                                                                       |
| cd helloworld                                                         |
|                                                                       |
| grails                                                                |
|                                                                       |
| #创建一个controller                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| create-controller hello                                               |
|                                                                       |
| #运行                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| run-app                                                               |
|                                                                       |
| #指定端口号启动                                                       |
|                                                                       |
| run-app --port=8090                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #停止运行                                                             |
|                                                                       |
| stop-app                                                              |
|                                                                       |
| #调试                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| run-app --debug-jvm                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| #打包                                                                 |
|                                                                       |
| grails war                                                            |
|                                                                       |

|                                                                       |
| grails  -Dgrails.env=production run-app                               |

| *#加个redis配置，实现共享session*                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
| dependencies {                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     implementation \'org.grails.plugins:spring-security-core:5.+\'                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     implementation group: \'org.springframework.session\', name: \'spring-session-data-redis\'                                 |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     implementation group: \'org.springframework.data\', name: \'spring-data-redis\'                                            |
|                                                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
| \@Configuration                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                |
| \@ConditionalOnProperty(name = \"spring.redis.enabled\", havingValue = \"true\")//打开redis来共享session                       |
|                                                                                                                                |
| \@EnableRedisHttpSession(redisNamespace = \"kps:session\", saveMode = org.springframework.session.SaveMode.ALWAYS)             |
|                                                                                                                                |
| classSessionConfig                                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                |
| {                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     StringredisHost                                                                                                            |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     IntegerredisPort                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     StringredisPassword                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     \@Bean                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     LettuceConnectionFactoryconnectionFactory()                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     {                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         def redisStandaloneConfiguration = newRedisStandaloneConfiguration(redisHost, redisPort)                               |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         if (redisPassword)                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         {                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                |
|             redisStandaloneConfiguration.password = newRedisPassword(redisPassword.toCharArray())                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         }                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         returnnewLettuceConnectionFactory(redisStandaloneConfiguration)                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
| *#再后来，领导吃饱了想支持一个账号只能一个用户登录，单用户登录，并发为1*                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.core.Authentication                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.core.session.SessionRegistry                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.SessionAuthenticationException                                   |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.SessionAuthenticationStrategy                                    |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importjavax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importjavax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                                |
| classSingleSessionAuthenticationStrategyimplementsSessionAuthenticationStrategy {                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     SessionRegistrysessionRegistry                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     SingleSessionAuthenticationStrategy(SessionRegistrysessionRegistry){                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         this.sessionRegistry = sessionRegistry                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     \@Override                                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     voidonAuthentication(Authenticationauthentication, HttpServletRequestrequest, HttpServletResponseresponse)                 |
| throwsSessionAuthenticationException {                                                                                         |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         def sessions = sessionRegistry.getAllSessions(authentication.getPrincipal(), false)                                    |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         sessions.each {                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                                                                |
|             if (it.principal == authentication.getPrincipal()) {                                                               |
|                                                                                                                                |
|                 //相同就让他们下线                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                                |
|                 it.expireNow()                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                |
|             }                                                                                                                  |
|                                                                                                                                |
|         }                                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                                |

|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.RegisterSessionAuthenticationStrategy                            |
|                                                                                                                                |
| importorg.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.SessionFixationProtectionStrategy                                |
|                                                                                                                                |

| beans = {                                                                                                                      |

|                                                                           ref(\'registerSessionAuthenticationStrategy\')\])    |

|                                                                                                                |
|     at org.gjt.xpp.jaxp11.SAXParserImpl.\<init\>(SAXParserImpl.java:132)                                       |
|                                                                                                                |
|     at org.gjt.xpp.jaxp11.SAXParserFactoryImpl.newSAXParserImpl(SAXParserFactoryImpl.java:114)                 |
|                                                                                                                |
|     at org.gjt.xpp.jaxp11.SAXParserFactoryImpl.setFeature(SAXParserFactoryImpl.java:142)                       |
|                                                                                                                |
|     at ch.qos.logback.core.joran.event.SaxEventRecorder.buildSaxParser(SaxEventRecorder.java:82)               |
|                                                                                                                |
| 原因：阿里云的包里面有 SAXParserFactory 的实现类，与默认实现不兼容，导致 logback                               |
| 初始化报错，报错的关键位置在ch.qos.logback.core.joran.event.SaxEventRecorder#buildSaxParser                    |
|                                                                                                                |
|  privateSAXParserbuildSaxParser() throws JoranException {                                                      |
|                                                                                                                |
|     try {                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                |
|         SAXParserFactoryspf = SAXParserFactory.newInstance();                                                  |
|                                                                                                                |
|         spf.setValidating(false);                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                |
|         //spf.setFeature(\"http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl\", true);                      |
|                                                                                                                |
|         spf.setFeature(\"http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities\", false);                      |
|                                                                                                                |
|         spf.setFeature(\"http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities\", false);                    |
|                                                                                                                |
|         spf.setNamespaceAware(true);                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                |
|         returnspf.newSAXParser();                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                |
|     } catch (Exceptionpce) {                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                |
|         StringerrMsg = \"Parser configuration error occurred\";                                                |
|                                                                                                                |
|         addError(errMsg, pce);                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                |
|         thrownewJoranException(errMsg, pce);                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                |
|     }                                                                                                          |
|                                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                |
| 解决 :加入排出依赖                                                                                             |
|                                                                                                                |
| // https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.aliyun/dysmsapi20170525                                              |
|                                                                                                                |
| implementation(group: \'com.aliyun\', name: \'dysmsapi20170525\', version: \'2.0.23\'){                        |
|                                                                                                                |
|     [exclude group: \'pull-parser\', module: \'pull-parser\']{.mark}                                           |
|                                                                                                                |
| }                                                                                                              |

## 悲观锁问题

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| http://kpscore-dev.yunfangdata.com/dpi/execute?code=xADWokxSFqrxlz0N&accountExternalId=358f5eb811074b81998b10561af618b2 |
|                                                                                                                         |
| { param-\>                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     def estate1 = com.next.Estate.findWhere(id:215823L)                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     Thread.sleep(100000)                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     estate1.callbackUrl = \'bb1\'                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     estate1.save()                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     return \[\"a\": \"bb1\"\]                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                         |
| }                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
| http://kpscore-dev.yunfangdata.com/dpi/execute?code=tfLDi9wlbpYI9sku&accountExternalId=358f5eb811074b81998b10561af618b2 |
|                                                                                                                         |
| { param-\>                                                                                                              |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     def estate1 = com.next.Estate.findWhere(id:215823L)                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     Thread.sleep(30000)                                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     estate1.callbackUrl = \'bb2\'                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     estate1.save()                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     return \[\"a\": \"bb2\"\]                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                         |
| }                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
| 参考                                                                                                                    |
|                                                                                                                         |
| https://docs.grails.org/6.2.0/ref/Database%20Mapping/version.html                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
| classEstate {                                                                                                           |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     \...                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     staticmapping = {                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                         |
|         version false                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                         |
|     }                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                                                         |
| }                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                         |
| bb1 10秒    先执行                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                         |
| bb2  3秒    后执行                                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                         |
| 结果应该是bb1 ,因为最后提交的是bb1                                                                                      |
|                                                                                                                         |
| 如果不设置version false , 数据库里存的结果是bb2                                                                         |

配置文件application.yml

  ssl:\

  **key-store-password:** tianjin\

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

Spring boot (http和https)俩个端口同时开启

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **import** org.apache.catalina.connector.Connector\
  **import** org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value\
  **import**
  org.springframework.boot.web.embedded.tomcat.TomcatServletWebServerFactory\
  **import**
  org.springframework.boot.web.servlet.server.ServletWebServerFactory\
  **import** org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean\
  **import** org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration\
  \
  \@Configuration\
  **class** SSLConfig {\
  \
  \@Value(**\'\${server.httpPort}\'**)\
  Integer **httpPort\**
  \@Value(**\'\${server.httpsPort}\'**)\
  Integer **httpsPort\
  \**
  \@Bean\
  ServletWebServerFactory servletContainer() {\
  TomcatServletWebServerFactory tomcat = **new**
  TomcatServletWebServerFactory();\
  tomcat.setPort(**httpsPort**)\
  tomcat.addAdditionalTomcatConnectors(createConnectors());\
  **return** tomcat;\
  }\
  \
  **def** createConnectors(){\
  Connector connector = **new**
  Connector(**\"org.apache.coyote.http11.Http11NioProtocol\"**);\
  connector.setScheme(**\"http\"**);\
  connector.setSecure(**false**);\
  connector.setPort(**httpPort**);*//http的端口\*
  connector.setRedirectPort(**httpsPort**);\
  **return** connector\
  }\
  \
  \
  }
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 异步执行@Async

Spring boot 主main方法启用异步@EnableAsync注解

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **package** com;\                                                     |
| **import** org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;\               |
| **import**                                                            |
| org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;\        |
| **import** org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableAsync;     |
|                                                                       |
| **\@EnableAsync**\                                                    |
| \@SpringBootApplication\                                              |
| **public class** App {\                                               |
| **public static void** main(String\[\] args) **throws** Exception {\  |
| SpringApplication.*run*(App.**class**, args);\                        |
| }\                                                                    |
| }                                                                     |
+=======================================================================+

在类里的方法上加入异步@Async注解

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **package** com;                                                      |
|                                                                       |
| **import** org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Async;\          |
| **import** org.springframework.stereotype.Component;                  |
|                                                                       |
| \@Component\                                                          |
| **public class** ReportFactory {                                      |
|                                                                       |
| > \@Async\                                                            |
| > **public void** asyncService(){\                                    |
| > System.***out***.println(**\"异步执行\"**);\                        |
| > }                                                                   |
|                                                                       |
| }                                                                     |
+=======================================================================+

## 定时任务

spring boot完美支持定时任务，配定时超简单

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| \@Scheduled(cron=**\"0 0 17 \* \* ?\"**)                                      |
|                                                                               |
| *Seconds : 可出现\", - \* /\"四个字符，有效范围为0-59的整数\                  |
| Minutes : 可出现\", - \* /\"四个字符，有效范围为0-59的整数\                   |
| Hours : 可出现\", - \* /\"四个字符，有效范围为0-23的整数\                     |
| DayofMonth : 可出现\", - \* / ? L W C\"八个字符，有效范围为0-31的整数\        |
| Month : 可出现\", - \* /\"四个字符，有效范围为1-12的整数或JAN-DEc\            |
| DayofWeek : 可出现\", - \* / ? L C                                            |
| #\"四个字符，有效范围为1-7的整数或SUN-SAT两个范围。1表示星期天，2表示星期一， |
| 依次类推\                                                                     |
| Year : 可出现\", - \* /\"四个字符，有效范围为1970-2099年\                     |
| \                                                                             |
| \"0 0 12 \* \* ?\" 每天中午十二点触发\                                        |
| \"0 15 10 ? \* \*\" 每天早上10：15触发\                                       |
| \"0 15 10 \* \* ?\" 每天早上10：15触发\                                       |
| \"0 15 10 \* \* ? \*\" 每天早上10：15触发\                                    |
| \"0 15 10 \* \* ? 2005\" 2005年的每天早上10：15触发\                          |
| \"0 \* 14 \* \* ?\" 每天从下午2点开始到2点59分每分钟一次触发\                 |
| \"0 0/5 14 \* \* ?\" 每天从下午2点开始到2：55分结束每5分钟一次触发\           |
| \"0 0/5 14,18 \* \* ?\"                                                       |
| 每天的下午2点至2：55和6点至6点55分两个时间段内每5分钟一次触发\                |
| \"0 0-5 14 \* \* ?\" 每天14:00至14:05每分钟一次触发\                          |
| \"0 10,44 14 ? 3 WED\" 三月的每周三的14：10和14：44触发\                      |
| \"0 15 10 ? \* MON-FRI\" 每个周一、周二、周三、周四、周五的10：15触发*        |
+===============================================================================+

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.yf.task;\
  \
  **import** org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.EnableScheduling;\
  **import** org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;\
  \
  \@EnableScheduling\
  **public class** TaskTest {\
  \
  \@Scheduled(cron=**\"0 0 17 \* \* ?\"**)\
  **public void** MailSendTask() {\
  System.***out***.println(**\"每天5点执行\"**);\
  }\
  }
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.yf.utils;\
  \
  **import** org.springframework.core.io.InputStreamSource;\
  **import** org.springframework.mail.javamail.JavaMailSenderImpl;\
  **import** org.springframework.mail.javamail.MimeMessageHelper;\
  **import** org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\
  \
  **import** javax.mail.internet.MimeMessage;\
  **import** java.util.Map;\
  **import** java.util.Properties;\
  \
  \@Component\
  **public class** MailUtil {\
  \
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 代理发送邮件\
  \* **\@param toUser** 发送给谁，fei.wang@yunfangdata.com\
  \* **\@param title** 邮件标题\
  \* **\@param html** 邮件内容，可用html\
  \* **\@param fujian** 附件\
  \* **\@return\**
  \*/\*
  **public boolean** Send(String \[\] toUser, String title, String html,
  Map\<String,InputStreamSource\> fujian){\
  **try** {\
  JavaMailSenderImpl senderImpl = **new** JavaMailSenderImpl();\
  MimeMessage mailMessage = senderImpl.createMimeMessage();\
  MimeMessageHelper messageHelper = **new**
  MimeMessageHelper(mailMessage, **true**, **\"utf-8\"**);\
  messageHelper.setFrom(**\"work@yunfangdata.com\"**);\
  senderImpl.setHost(**\"smtp.yunfangdata.com\"**);\
  senderImpl.setPort(80);\
  senderImpl.setUsername(**\"work@yunfangdata.com\"**);\
  senderImpl.setPassword(**\"Yunfangdata123#\"**);\
  Properties prop = **new** Properties();\
  prop.put(**\"mail.smtp.auth\"**, **\"true\"**);\
  prop.put(**\"mail.smtp.timeout\"**, **\"25000\"**);\
  senderImpl.setJavaMailProperties(prop);\
  messageHelper.setTo(toUser);\
  messageHelper.setSubject(title);\
  messageHelper.setText(html, **true**);\
  **if**(fujian != **null**){\
  **for** (String k : fujian.keySet()) {\
  messageHelper.addAttachment(k, fujian.get(k));\
  }\
  }\
  senderImpl.send(mailMessage);\
  }**catch**(Exception e){\
  e.printStackTrace();\
  **return false**;\
  }\
  **return true**;\
  }\
  }

| **private** HttpServletRequest createRequest(Map\<String,Object\>     |
| mpara){\                                                              |
| Parameters para =**new** Parameters();\                               |
| **for**(String key : mpara.keySet()){\                                |
| para.addParameter(key,String.*valueOf*(mpara.get(key)));\             |
| }\                                                                    |
| org.apache.coyote.Request coyotRequest =**new**                       |
| org.apache.coyote.Request();\                                         |

| rr.setCoyoteRequest(coyotRequest);\                                   |
| rr.setConnector(**new** Connector(**\"HTTP/1.1\"**));\                |
| **this**.setField(rr,**\"parametersParsed\"**,**true**);\             |
| **return new** RequestFacade(rr);\                                    |
| }                                                                     |

| } **catch** (IllegalAccessException e) {\                             |

## Spring boot 多数据源

Spring
boot多数据源实现AbstractRoutingDataSource类进行路由，关键实现创建SqlSessionFactoryBean对象方法，并设置数源走AbstractRoutingDataSource的实现类（自己写代码实现），否则spring
boot默认走默认数据源。写自定义注解在DAO方法上，使用AOP实现DAO层的动态切面植入动态切换数据源的代码。

- 数据库路由类

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.yf.config;\
  \
  **import** org.apache.ibatis.session.SqlSessionFactory;\
  **import** org.mybatis.spring.SqlSessionFactoryBean;\
  **import** org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties;\
  **import** org.springframework.boot.jdbc.DataSourceBuilder;\
  **import** org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;\
  **import** org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;\
  **import** org.springframework.context.annotation.Primary;\
  **import** org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.DataSourceTransactionManager;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.jdbc.datasource.lookup.AbstractRoutingDataSource;\
  **import** org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.transaction.annotation.EnableTransactionManagement;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.transaction.annotation.TransactionManagementConfigurer;\
  \
  **import** javax.sql.DataSource;\
  **import** java.util.HashMap;\
  **import** java.util.Map;\
  \
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 数据库路由\
  \*/\*
  \@Configuration*\*
  **public class** YfRoutingDataSouce **implements**
  TransactionManagementConfigurer {\
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 从dao拦截器中设置当前数据源的key\
  \*/\*
  **public static** ThreadLocal\<YfDataSourceType\>*dsType* =**new**
  ThreadLocal();\
  \
  \@Autowired\
  DataSource **dataSource**;\
  \
  \@Bean\
  \@Primary\
  \@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = **\"spring.datasource\"**)\
  **public** DataSource DataSource() {\
  **return** DataSourceBuilder.*create*().build();\
  }\
  \
  \
  \@Bean\
  \@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = **\"wf.mysql.datasource\"**)\
  **public** DataSource DataSource1() {\
  **return** DataSourceBuilder.*create*().build();\
  }\
  \
  \
  \@Bean\
  [**public** DataSource dynamicDataSource()]{.mark} {\
  yfRouting yfRouting = **new** yfRouting();\
  Map\<Object, Object\> dataSourceMap = **new** HashMap\<\>();\
  dataSourceMap.put(YfDataSourceType.***master***, DataSource());\
  dataSourceMap.put(YfDataSourceType.***wf***, DataSource1());\
  yfRouting.setDefaultTargetDataSource(DataSource());\
  yfRouting.setTargetDataSources(dataSourceMap);\
  **return** yfRouting;\
  }\
  \
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 生成一个SqlSessionFactory类对象\
  \* **\@return\**
  \* **\@throws** Exception\
  \*/\*
  \@Bean\
  **public** SqlSessionFactory sqlSessionFactoryBean() **throws** Exception {\
  SqlSessionFactoryBean bean = **new** SqlSessionFactoryBean();\
  [bean.setDataSource(dynamicDataSource());]{.mark}*//多数据源路由的关键\*
  **return** bean.getObject();\
  }\
  \
  \@Override\
  **public** PlatformTransactionManager annotationDrivenTransactionManager() {\
  **return new** DataSourceTransactionManager(**dataSource**);\
  }\
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 实现路由数据源功能\
  \*/\*
  **class** yfRouting **extends** AbstractRoutingDataSource{\
  \
  \@Override\
  **protected** Object determineCurrentLookupKey() {\
  **return** *dsType*.get();\
  }\
  }\
  \
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 枚举数据库key\
  \*/\*
  **public enum** YfDataSourceType{\
  */\*\*\
  \* 主数据库\
  \*/\
  **master***,\
  */\*\*\
  \* 测试用的\
  \*/\
  **wf\***
  }\
  \
  }

- 编写注解实现在dao方法上标注数据源

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.yf.annotation;\
  \
  **import** com.yf.config.YfRoutingDataSouce;\
  \
  **import** java.lang.annotation.\*;\
  \
  */\*\*\
  \* 注解数据源，在dao中添加数据源注解，动态切换数据源\
  \*/\*
  \@Documented\
  \@Retention(RetentionPolicy.***RUNTIME***)\
  \@Target(ElementType.***METHOD***)\
  **public** @**interface** YfDataSource {\
  \
  YfRoutingDataSouce.YfDataSourceType value() **default**
  YfRoutingDataSouce.YfDataSourceType.***master***;\
  \
  }
  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------

- 编写dao方法的拦截器进行切换

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.yf.intercepts;\
  \
  **import** com.yf.annotation.YfDataSource;\
  **import** com.yf.config.YfRoutingDataSouce;\
  **import** org.aspectj.lang.JoinPoint;\
  **import** org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Aspect;\
  **import** org.aspectj.lang.annotation.Before;\
  **import** org.aspectj.lang.reflect.MethodSignature;\
  **import** org.springframework.core.annotation.Order;\
  **import** org.springframework.stereotype.Component;\
  \
  \@Aspect\
  \@Component\
  \@Order(0)\
  **public class** DaoIntercept {\
  \
  \@Before(**\"execution(\* com.\*.dao.\*.\*(..))\"**)\
  **public void** \_befor(JoinPoint pjp) {\
  System.***out***.println(**\"++++++++++++++++++++YfDataSource\"**);\
  MethodSignature methodSignature = (MethodSignature)pjp.getSignature();\
  YfDataSource ydb =
  methodSignature.getMethod().getAnnotation(YfDataSource.**class**);\
  **if**(ydb != **null**){\
  YfRoutingDataSouce.*dsType*.set(ydb.value());\
  }\
  \
  }\
  }

| **class** ReportDigitalChapter {\                                                                                     |

| **def** sign(**byte**\[\] report){\                                                                                   |
| **def** key = **new** FileInputStream(**\"/mnt/d/work/kps/src/main/webapp/key/jd2020_private_key.pfx\"**)             |
|                                                                                                                       |
| com.itextpdf.text.Image image =                                                                                       |
| com.itextpdf.text.Image.*getInstance*(**\"http://ressy.yunfangdata.com/d760dc17-9e68-42dc-9a42-1a237c8aa740.png\"**)\ |
| **def** param = \[\                                                                                                   |
| \[**rectangle**:**new** com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle(300,100,200,200),**page**:2,**image**:image\]\                    |
| ,\[**rectangle**:**new** com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle(700,200,200,300),**page**:3,**image**:image\]\                   |
| ,\[**rectangle**:**new** com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle(770,200,270,250),**page**:3,**image**:image\]\                   |
| ,\[**rectangle**:**new** com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle(500,600,200,700),**page**:17,**image**:image\]\                  |
| \]\                                                                                                                   |
| sign(key,**\"1\"**,**new** ByteArrayInputStream(report),param)\                                                       |
| }\                                                                                                                    |
| \                                                                                                                     |
| **def** sign(InputStream key,String passWd,InputStream inPdf,List\<Map\<String,Object\>\> param){\                    |
| **def** osPdf = **null\**                                                                                             |
| BouncyCastleProvider provider = **new** BouncyCastleProvider()\                                                       |
| Security.*addProvider*(provider)\                                                                                     |
| KeyStore ks = KeyStore.*getInstance*(**\"JKS\"**)\                                                                    |
| ks.load(key, passWd.toCharArray())\                                                                                   |
| String alias = (String) ks.aliases().nextElement()\                                                                   |
| PrivateKey privateKey = (PrivateKey) ks.getKey(alias, passWd.toCharArray())\                                          |
| Certificate\[\] chain = ks.getCertificateChain(alias)\                                                                |
| **for**(Map it : param){\                                                                                             |
| **if**(osPdf){\                                                                                                       |
| inPdf = **new** ByteArrayInputStream(osPdf.toByteArray())\                                                            |
| }\                                                                                                                    |
| osPdf = **new** ByteArrayOutputStream()\                                                                              |
| sign(inPdf,osPdf,it\[**\"rectangle\"**\] **as** com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle,it\[**\"page\"**\] **as** Integer,        |
| it\[**\"image\"**\] **as** Image, privateKey,chain,provider.getName())\                                               |
| }\                                                                                                                    |
| osPdf.toByteArray()\                                                                                                  |
| }\                                                                                                                    |
| \                                                                                                                     |
| **def** sign(InputStream inPdf,OutputStream osPdf,com.itextpdf.text.Rectangle rectangle,**int** page,Image            |
| image,PrivateKey privateKey,Certificate\[\] chain,String provider){\                                                  |
| **def** reader = **new** PdfReader(inPdf)\                                                                            |
| **def** stp = PdfStamper.*createSignature*(reader, osPdf, (**char**)**\'\\0\'**, **null**, **true**)\                 |
| stp.setFullCompression()\                                                                                             |
| PdfSignatureAppearance sap = stp.getSignatureAppearance()\                                                            |
| sap.setReason(**\"九鼎报告\"**)\                                                                                      |
| sap.setLocation(**\"成都\"**)\                                                                                        |
| sap.setImageScale(0)\                                                                                                 |
| sap.setSignatureGraphic(image)\                                                                                       |
| sap.setRenderingMode(PdfSignatureAppearance.RenderingMode.***GRAPHIC***)\                                             |
| sap.setVisibleSignature(rectangle, page, UUID.*randomUUID*().toString().replaceAll(**\"-\"**, **\"\"**))\             |
| stp.getWriter().setCompressionLevel(5)\                                                                               |
| ExternalDigest digest = **new** BouncyCastleDigest()\                                                                 |
| ExternalSignature signature = **new** PrivateKeySignature(privateKey, DigestAlgorithms.***SHA512***, provider)\       |
| MakeSignature.*signDetached*(sap, digest, signature, chain, **null**, **null**, **null**, 0,                          |
| MakeSignature.CryptoStandard.***CADES***)\                                                                            |
| stp.close()\                                                                                                          |
| reader.close()\                                                                                                       |
| }\                                                                                                                    |
| \                                                                                                                     |
| }                                                                                                                     |

问题

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **在spring boot和grails run-app内置tomcat下没有问题，grails war 打成war包放到tomcat下报错**                                                                 |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| java.lang.**SecurityException**: class \"org.bouncycastle.cms.Recipient\"\'s signer information does not match signer information of other classes in the   |
| same package                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| 这是由于grails中引用了低版本的bcprov-jdk14-138.jar，和bcprov-jdk15on-1.49.jar冲突导致的，需要设置一下引用关系，最简单的方式是直接删除bcprov-jdk14-138.jar包 |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| bcmail-jdk14-1.38.jar                                                                                                                                       |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| bcmail-jdk14-138.jar                                                                                                                                        |

  **public** ConfigurableApplicationContext run(String\... args) {\
  StopWatch stopWatch = **new** StopWatch();\
  stopWatch.start();*//记录一下时间，到最后要算启动时间\*
  ConfigurableApplicationContext context = **null**;\
  Collection\<SpringBootExceptionReporter\> exceptionReporters = **new** ArrayList();\
  **this**.configureHeadlessProperty();\
  SpringApplicationRunListeners listeners = **this**.getRunListeners(args);\
  listeners.starting();\
  \
  **try** {\
  ApplicationArguments applicationArguments = **new** DefaultApplicationArguments(args);\
  ConfigurableEnvironment environment = **this**.prepareEnvironment(listeners,
  applicationArguments);\
  **this**.configureIgnoreBeanInfo(environment);\
  Banner printedBanner = **this**.printBanner(environment);\
  context = **this**.createApplicationContext();\
  **this**.getSpringFactoriesInstances(SpringBootExceptionReporter.**class**, **new**
  Class\[\]{ConfigurableApplicationContext.**class**}, context);\
  **this**.prepareContext(context, environment, listeners, applicationArguments,
  printedBanner);\
  **this**.refreshContext(context);\
  **this**.afterRefresh(context, applicationArguments);\
  stopWatch.stop();\
  **if** (**this**.logStartupInfo) {\
  (**new**
  StartupInfoLogger(**this**.mainApplicationClass)).logStarted(**this**.getApplicationLog(),
  stopWatch);\
  }\
  \
  listeners.started(context);\
  **this**.callRunners(context, applicationArguments);\
  } **catch** (Throwable var9) {\
  **this**.handleRunFailure(context, listeners, exceptionReporters, var9);\
  **throw new** IllegalStateException(var9);\
  }\
  \
  listeners.running(context);\
  **return** context;\
  }

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **public void** refresh() **throws** BeansException,
  IllegalStateException {\
  **synchronized** (**this**.**startupShutdownMonitor**) {\
  *// Prepare this context for refreshing.刷新前置方法\*
  prepareRefresh();\
  \
  *// Tell the subclass to refresh the internal bean
  factory.刷新bean工厂\*
  ConfigurableListableBeanFactory beanFactory =
  obtainFreshBeanFactory();\
  \
  *// Prepare the bean factory for use in this context.
  bean工厂的前置处理\*
  prepareBeanFactory(beanFactory);\
  \
  **try** {\
  *// Allows post-processing of the bean factory in context
  subclasses.对bean工厂进行后处理\*
  postProcessBeanFactory(beanFactory);\
  \
  *// Invoke factory processors registered as beans in the
  context.调用bean工厂的后处理\*
  invokeBeanFactoryPostProcessors(beanFactory);\
  \
  *// Register bean processors that intercept bean
  creation.注册创建拦截bean的bean\*
  registerBeanPostProcessors(beanFactory);\
  \
  *// Initialize message source for this context.初始化此上下文的消息源\*
  initMessageSource();\
  \
  *// Initialize event multicaster for this
  context.初始化此上下文的事件广播器\*
  initApplicationEventMulticaster();\
  \
  *// Initialize other special beans in specific context
  subclasses.初始化其他特殊bean\*
  onRefresh();*//创建web服务\*
  \
  *// Check for listener beans and register them.检查监听器\*
  registerListeners();\
  \
  *// Instantiate all remaining (non-lazy-init)
  singletons.实例化所有剩余（非延迟初始化）单例\*
  finishBeanFactoryInitialization(beanFactory);*//实例化bean\*
  \
  *// Last step: publish corresponding event.发布相应的事件\*
  finishRefresh();*//完成刷新，启动tomcat容器\*
  }\
  \
  **catch** (BeansException ex) {\
  **if** (**logger**.isWarnEnabled()) {\
  **logger**.warn(**\"Exception encountered during context
  initialization - \"** +\
  **\"cancelling refresh attempt: \"** + ex);\
  }\
  \
  *// Destroy already created singletons to avoid dangling resources.\*
  destroyBeans();\
  \
  *// Reset \'active\' flag.\*
  cancelRefresh(ex);\
  \
  *// Propagate exception to caller.\*
  **throw** ex;\
  }\
  \
  **finally** {\
  *// Reset common introspection caches in Spring\'s core, since we\
  // might not ever need metadata for singleton beans anymore\...\*
  resetCommonCaches();\
  }\
  }\
  }

  **protected** HandlerMethod getHandlerInternal(HttpServletRequest
  request) **throws** Exception {\
  String lookupPath =
  **this**.getUrlPathHelper().getLookupPathForRequest(request);\
  **if** (**this**.logger.isDebugEnabled()) {\
  **this**.logger.debug(**\"Looking up handler method for path \"** +
  lookupPath);\
  }\
  \
  **this**.mappingRegistry.acquireReadLock();\
  \
  HandlerMethod var4;\
  **try** {\
  HandlerMethod handlerMethod = **this**.lookupHandlerMethod(lookupPath,
  request);\
  **if** (**this**.logger.isDebugEnabled()) {\
  **if** (handlerMethod != **null**) {\
  **this**.logger.debug(**\"Returning handler method \[\"** +
  handlerMethod + **\"\]\"**);\
  } **else** {\
  **this**.logger.debug(**\"Did not find handler method for \[\"** +
  lookupPath + **\"\]\"**);\
  }\
  }\
  \
  var4 = handlerMethod != **null** ?
  handlerMethod.createWithResolvedBean() : **null**;\
  } **finally** {\
  **this**.mappingRegistry.releaseReadLock();\
  }\
  \
  **return** var4;\
  }

org.springframework.web.servlet.DispatcherServlet当请求过来的时候，先进入doDispatch方法

  ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  **protected void** doDispatch(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
  **throws** Exception {\
  HttpServletRequest processedRequest = request;\
  HandlerExecutionChain mappedHandler = **null**;\
  **boolean** multipartRequestParsed = **false**;\
  WebAsyncManager asyncManager = WebAsyncUtils.getAsyncManager(request);\
  \
  **try** {\
  **try** {\
  ModelAndView mv = **null**;\
  Object dispatchException = **null**;\
  \
  **try** {\
  processedRequest = **this**.checkMultipart(request);\
  multipartRequestParsed = processedRequest != request;\
  mappedHandler = **this**.getHandler(processedRequest);\
  **if** (mappedHandler == **null**) {\
  **this**.noHandlerFound(processedRequest, response);\
  **return**;\
  }\
  \
  HandlerAdapter ha =
  **this**.getHandlerAdapter(mappedHandler.getHandler());//获取Controller里的处理方法，封装在ha\
  String method = request.getMethod();\
  **boolean** isGet = **\"GET\"**.equals(method);\
  **if** (isGet \|\| **\"HEAD\"**.equals(method)) {\
  **long** lastModified = ha.getLastModified(request, mappedHandler.getHandler());\
  **if** (**this**.logger.isDebugEnabled()) {\
  **this**.logger.debug(**\"Last-Modified value for \[\"** + getRequestUri(request) + **\"\] is:
  \"** + lastModified);\
  }\
  \
  **if** ((**new** ServletWebRequest(request, response)).checkNotModified(lastModified) && isGet)
  {\
  **return**;\
  }\
  }\
  \
  **if** (!mappedHandler.applyPreHandle(processedRequest, response)) {\
  **return**;\
  }\
  \
  mv = ha.handle(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler.getHandler());//执行Controller里的方法\
  **if** (asyncManager.isConcurrentHandlingStarted()) {\
  **return**;\
  }\
  \
  **this**.applyDefaultViewName(processedRequest, mv);\
  mappedHandler.applyPostHandle(processedRequest, response, mv);\
  } **catch** (Exception var20) {\
  dispatchException = var20;\
  } **catch** (Throwable var21) {\
  dispatchException = **new** NestedServletException(**\"Handler dispatch failed\"**, var21);\
  }\
  \
  **this**.processDispatchResult(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, mv,
  (Exception)dispatchException);\
  } **catch** (Exception var22) {\
  **this**.triggerAfterCompletion(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, var22);\
  } **catch** (Throwable var23) {\
  **this**.triggerAfterCompletion(processedRequest, response, mappedHandler, **new**
  NestedServletException(**\"Handler processing failed\"**, var23));\
  }\
  \
  } **finally** {\
  **if** (asyncManager.isConcurrentHandlingStarted()) {\
  **if** (mappedHandler != **null**) {\
  mappedHandler.applyAfterConcurrentHandlingStarted(processedRequest, response);\
  }\
  } **else if** (multipartRequestParsed) {\
  **this**.cleanupMultipart(processedRequest);\
  }\
  \
  }\
  }

  **fun** replaceAllText(sele:Dispatch,findText:String,newText:String){\
  **val** find = Dispatch.call(sele, **\"Find\"**).toDispatch()\
  Dispatch.put(find, **\"Text\"**, findText)\

  **fun**
  replaceSeekView(word:ActiveXComponent,text1:String,text2:String){\
  **val** activeWindow =
  word.getProperty(**\"ActiveWindow\"**).toDispatch()\
  **val** activePane = Dispatch.get(activeWindow,
  **\"ActivePane\"**).toDispatch()\
  **val** view = Dispatch.get(activePane, **\"View\"**).toDispatch()\
  \
  Dispatch.put(view, **\"SeekView\"**, **\"9\"**)\
  **val** sele = Dispatch.get(word, **\"Selection\"**).toDispatch()\
  \
  **val** find = Dispatch.call(sele, **\"Find\"**).toDispatch()\
  Dispatch.put(find, **\"Text\"**, text1)\
  Dispatch.put(find, **\"Forward\"**, **\"True\"**)\
  **val** stu = Dispatch.call(find, **\"Execute\"**)\
  **if** (stu.*boolean*) {\
  Dispatch.put(sele, **\"Text\"**, text2)\
  }*\*

  **fun**
  putPicture(word:ActiveXComponent,width:Int,Height:Int,ParamName:String,pricturePath:String){\
  *println*(**\"\-\-\-\-\-\--\$**ParamName **\$**pricturePath**\"**)\
  **val** sele = Dispatch.get(word, **\"Selection\"**).toDispatch()\
  **val** find = Dispatch.call(sele, **\"Find\"**).toDispatch()\
  Dispatch.put(find, **\"Text\"**, ParamName)\
  Dispatch.put(find, **\"Forward\"**, **\"True\"**)\
  **val** stu = Dispatch.call(find, **\"Execute\"**)\
  **if** (stu.*boolean*) {\
  Dispatch.call(sele, **\"Delete\"**)\
  **if**(pricturePath !=**\"\"**){\
  **val** picture = Dispatch.call(Dispatch.get(sele, **\"InLineShapes\"**).toDispatch(),
  **\"AddPicture\"**, pricturePath).toDispatch()\
  Dispatch.call(picture, **\"Select\"**)\
  **if**(width != 0 && Height !=0){\
  Dispatch.put(picture, **\"Width\"**, Variant(width))\
  Dispatch.put(picture, **\"Height\"**, Variant(Height))\
  }\
  }\
  Dispatch.call(sele, **\"HomeKey\"**, Variant(6))\
  }\
  }

  **fun** removeTable(documents:Dispatch,tableIndex:IntArray?){\
  **if**(tableIndex!= **null** && tableIndex?.**size**\>0){\
  **for**(i **in** tableIndex){\
  **val** tables = Dispatch.get(documents, **\"Tables\"**).toDispatch()\
  **try** {\
  **val** table = Dispatch.call(tables, **\"Item\"**, Variant(i)).toDispatch()\
  Dispatch.call(table, **\"Delete\"**)\
  }**catch**(ee: Exception){\
  *println*(**\"\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--\\n\"**+ee.**message**)\
  }\
  }\
  }\
  }

# spring cloud

https://www.w3cschool.cn/spring_cloud/

Spring Cloud Eureka是Spring Cloud Netflix项目下的服务治理模块。而Spring
Cloud Netflix项目是Spring
Cloud的子项目之一，主要内容是对Netflix公司一系列开源产品的包装，它为Spring
Boot应用提供了自配置的Netflix
OSS整合。通过一些简单的注解，开发者就可以快速的在应用中配置一下常用模块并构建庞大的分布式系统。它主要提供的模块包括：服务发现（Eureka），断路器（Hystrix），智能路由（Zuul），客户端负载均衡（Ribbon）等。

## 服务发现Eureka

- 启动文件main方法，需要@EnableEurekaServer注解说明是一个服务发现者，注册和引导服务发现用的

  -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  **package** com.cloud;\
  \
  **import** org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;\
  **import**
  org.springframework.cloud.netflix.eureka.server.EnableEurekaServer;\
  \
  \@SpringBootApplication\
  \@EnableEurekaServer\
  **public class** EurekaStart {\
  \
  **public static void** main(String\[\] args){\
  SpringApplication.*run*(EurekaStart.**class**, args);\
  }\
  }

  **client:\

  **fetch-registry:** false\
  **service-url:\
  defaultZone:**
  http://\${**eureka.instance.hostname**}:\${**server.port**}/eureka

  \@RequestMapping(**\"/wf\"**)

  String one();//接口方法无所谓，主要是和controller层进行对应调用\

  \@Configuration\
  **public class** kafka08Consumer {\
  \
  **private** String **groupId** = **\"YFStatistics\"**;*//yfDataAPIGuard\
  \*
  \@Value(**\"\${kafka.topic.xjapiaccesslog}\"**)\
  **private** String **topic**;\
  \
  \@Value(**\"\${zookeeper.address}\"**)\
  **private** String **zookeeperAddress**;\
  \
  \@Bean\
  IntegrationFlow consumer() {\
  System.***out***.println(**\"======================starting consumer..\"**);\
  KafkaHighLevelConsumerMessageSourceSpec messageSourceSpec =
  Kafka.*inboundChannelAdapter*(\
  **new** ZookeeperConnect(**zookeeperAddress**)).consumerProperties(props -\>\
  props.put(**\"auto.offset.reset\"**,
  **\"smallest\"**).put(**\"auto.commit.interval.ms\"**, **\"100\"**))\
  .addConsumer(**groupId**, metadata -\> metadata.consumerTimeout(100)\
  .topicStreamMap(m -\> m.put(**topic**, 1))\
  .maxMessages(1)\
  .valueDecoder(String::**new**));\
  Consumer\<SourcePollingChannelAdapterSpec\> endpointConfigurer = e -\> e.poller(p -\>
  p.fixedDelay(100));\
  \
  **return** IntegrationFlows.*from*(messageSourceSpec, endpointConfigurer).\<Map\<String,
  Map\<Integer, List\<String\>\>\>\>handle((payload, headers) -\> {\
  payload.entrySet().forEach(e -\> {\
  e.getValue().entrySet().forEach(e2 -\> {\
  e2.getValue().forEach(e3 -\> {\
  getConsumerResult(e3);\
  });\
  });\
  });\
  **return null**;\
  })\
  .get();\
  }\
  \
  \
  **void** getConsumerResult(String ContumerResult){\
  System.***out***.println(**\"\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\--\"**+ContumerResult);\
  String\[\] c = ContumerResult.split(**\"@,@\"**);\
  \
  \
  \
  \
  }\
  \
  \
  }

# 编程语言

## java8- lambda表达式

lambda表达式允许你通过表达式来代替功能接口。
lambda表达式就和方法一样,它提供了一个正常的参数列表和一个使用这些参数的主体(body,可以是一个表达式或一个代码块)。

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **package** com.wf;\                                                  |
| \                                                                     |
| **public class** LambdaTest {\                                        |
| \                                                                     |
| */\*\*\                                                               |
| \* 声明个接口，一个接口只能有一个默认的接口方法\                      |
| \*/\*                                                                 |
| **interface** Num{\                                                   |
| **int** add(**int** a,**int** b);\                                    |
| }\                                                                    |
| \                                                                     |
| **interface** Mes{\                                                   |
| String say(String s);\                                                |
| }\                                                                    |
| \                                                                     |
| **public static void** main( String\[\] args ){\                      |
| Num cc = (**int** a, **int** b) -\> a + b;*//方法实现主体\*           |
| Mes mm = (String s) -\>**\"wo shi \"**+s;\                            |
| System.***out***.println(cc.add(2,3));\                               |
| System.***out***.println(mm.say(**\"wangfei\"**));                    |
|                                                                       |
| Map\<Integer, String\> map = **new** HashMap\<\>();\                  |
| map.put(1, **\"a\"**);\                                               |
| map.put(2, **\"b\"**);\                                               |
| map.forEach((key, value) -\> System.***out***.println(key + value));  |
|                                                                       |
| }\                                                                    |
| }                                                                     |

## volatile关键字

在早期的CPU当中，是通过在总线上加LOCK#锁的形式来解决缓存不一致的问题。因为CPU和其他部件进行通信都是通过总线来进行的，如果对总线加LOCK#锁的话，也就是说阻塞了其他CPU对其他部件访问（如内存），从而使得只能有一个CPU能使用这个变量的内存。比如上面例子中如果一个线程在执行
i = i
+1，如果在执行这段代码的过程中，在总线上发出了LCOK#锁的信号，那么只有等待这段代码完全执行完毕之后，其他CPU才能从变量i所在的内存读取变量，然后进行相应的操作。这样就解决了缓存不一致的问题。

但是上面的方式会有一个问题，由于在锁住总线期间，其他CPU无法访问内存，导致效率低下。

　　所以就出现了缓存一致性协议。最出名的就是Intel
的MESI协议，MESI协议保证了每个缓存中使用的共享变量的副本是一致的。它核心的思想是：当CPU写数据时，如果发现操作的变量是共享变量，即在其他CPU中也存在该变量的副本，会发出信号通知其他CPU将该变量的缓存行置为无效状态，因此当其他CPU需要读取这个变量时，发现自己缓存中缓存该变量的缓存行是无效的，那么它就会从内存重新读取

![https://images0.cnblogs.com/blog/288799/201408/212219343783699.jpg](media/image266.jpeg){width="7.0875in"
height="3.2519116360454943in"}

## groovy

Groovy 是类似 Ruby 的动态语言，适合编写脚本、插件、测试例，DSL
(领域特定语言)等。知名的自动化建构工具 Gradle 主要就基于 Groovy
。Java和Groovy之间存在很多差异，这使得Groovy开发的语言更加愉快，因为它减少了大量的样板代码，包括没有半冒号，没有getter
/
setter，类型推断，null安全，elvis操作符等等。但是，如果您愿意，那并不是说您不被允许使用Java表示法。有趣的是，大多数Java代码都将在groovy中编译，因此它对于进入该语言的标准较低。
